class GLLedgerReporter extends GLGroupReporter
{


    /* @var TextHelper $textHelper */
    protected $textHelper;

    /* @var string $multiAccSeparator */
    private $multiAccSeparator = '#~#';

    /* @var array $_gTranscationRecs */
    private $_gTranscationRecs = [];

    /* @var array $sourceBookIDMap */
    private $sourceBookIDMap = [];

    /** @var array $entityBookMapForTier */
    private $entityBookMapForTier = [];

    /* @var array $_gSubTranscationRecs */
    protected $_gSubTranscationRecs = [];

    /* @var int $_gSubTransCount */
    private $_gSubTransCount = 0;

    /* @var bool $_ytdbal */
    var $_ytdbal = false;

    /* @var array $acctFilterQueryArgs */
    var $acctFilterQueryArgs = [];

    //variable for GLREPORT DETAIL
    /* @var string $prentrylocationclause */
    var $prentrylocationclause = '';

    /* @var string $prentrylocargs */
    var $prentrylocargs = '';

    /* @var string $selforbilllines */
    var $selforbilllines = '';

    /* @var string $grpforbilllines */
    var $grpforbilllines = '';

    /* @var string $_basecurrency */
    private $_basecurrency;

    /* @var string $_offsetDetail */
    private $_offsetDetail;

    /* @var string $fiscalLoc */
    private $fiscalLoc;

    /* @var string[][] $_nativeToRptKeyedAcs */
    private $_nativeToRptKeyedAcs;

    /* @var string[][] $_gPeriodRecords */
    private $_gPeriodRecords;

    /* @var array $_gBalanceAsOfDate */
    private $_gBalanceAsOfDate;

    /* @var array $_offsetaccounts */
    private $_offsetaccounts;

    /* @var array $accountMap */
    private $accountMap;

    /* @var string[] $_gBookidJrnlSymbols */
    private $_gBookidJrnlSymbols;

    /* @var bool $isMultiAccount */
    private $isMultiAccount;

    /* @var string $multiAccontCaseStatment */
    private $multiAccontCaseStatment;

    /* @var array $_detailop */
    private $_detailop;

    /* @var float $_gr_tot_db */
    private $_gr_tot_db;

    /* @var float $_gr_tot_cr */
    private $_gr_tot_cr;

    /* @var float $_gr_tot_bal */
    private $_gr_tot_bal;

    /* @var string $_xmlStr */
    private $_xmlStr;

    /* @var array $_gTranscationOffsets */
    protected $_gTranscationOffsets;

    /* @var string[] $subsidiaryRecordKeyMap */
    private $subsidiaryRecordKeyMap = [];

    /* @var array $_txnStateMap */
    private $txnStateMap = array(
        'I' => 'IA.DRAFT',
        'S' => 'IA.SUBMITTED',
        'X' => 'IA.PARTIALLY_APPROVED',
        'A' => 'IA.APPROVED',
        'P' => 'IA.POSTED',
        'R' => 'IA.DECLINED',
        'L' => 'IA.REVERSAL_PENDING',
        'Z' => 'IA.REVERSED'
    );


    protected function getReporterId(array $params) : string
    {
        return 'gl_glrep';
    }

    /**
     * @param array $_params
     */
    function __construct($_params)
    {
        $_params = INTACCTarray_merge(
            $_params,
            [ 'report' => $this->getReporterId($_params),
              '2stage' => true ]
        );
        $this->textHelper = TextHelper::getInstance(__CLASS__, true);
        $token =
            [ 'IA.ADJUSTMENT', 'IA.ADVANCE', 'IA.AP_ADJUST', 'IA.AP_ADVANCE', 'IA.AP_APPLIED_PYMT', 'IA.AP_DISCOUNT',
              'IA.AP_PYMT', 'IA.AR_ADJUST', 'IA.AR_ADVANCE', 'IA.AR_APPLIED_PYMT', 'IA.AR_DISCOUNT', 'IA.AR_PYMT',
              'IA.EXPENSE_ADJUSTMENT',
              'IA.BILL', 'IA.CHECK', 'IA.DISCOUNT', 'IA.INVOICE', 'IA.EXP_RPT', 'IA.EE_APPLIED_PYMT', 'IA.EXP_PYMT',
              'IA.EXP_ADVANCE', 'IA.FILTER_TAB_AND_PROMPT_SELECTIONS', 'IA.REFUND',
            ];
        I18N::addTokens(I18N::tokenArrayToObjectArray($token));
        I18N::getText();
        parent::__construct($_params);

        /*-----------------------------------------------*/
        /* Add a non standard (custom) accounting period */
        /*    parameter to params and ensure that it is  */
        /*    '0' (false) or '1' (true)                  */
        /*-----------------------------------------------*/
        $gNonStandardPeriods =
        &Globals::$g->gNonStandardPeriods;
        $this->params['nonStandardPeriods'] =
            $gNonStandardPeriods;
        if ( $gNonStandardPeriods != '1' ) {
            $this->params['nonStandardPeriods'] = '0';
        }

        $myOp = GetOperationId('gl/reports/glledger');
        if ( ! IsOperationAllowed($myOp) || IsThroughAllowedOps($myOp) ) {
            $this->params['showdetail'] = 'D';
            $this->params['showsubtotal'] = 'false';
        }

        //we had to enforce reportslide = true only for background type reports because if GL is viewed for an entity we cannot
        //edit the transaction from drill down bug# 17428, 17379
        //on the other hand the offline report if filtered for an entity
        //should get created at the entity level so that the offline report is visible both to entity and root.
        /*if ( IsMultiEntityCompany() && $this->params['type'] == '_background' ) {
            $this->params['reportslide'] = true;
        }*/

        $this->params['ISGROUPLOC'] = isset($this->params['LOCATIONGROUPID']) ? 'true'
            : ($this->params['ISGROUPLOC'] ?? 'false');
        $this->params['ISGROUPDEPT'] = isset($this->params['DEPARTMENTGROUPID']) ? 'true'
            : ($this->params['ISGROUPDEPT'] ?? 'false');

        $this->_isgrouploc = $this->params['ISGROUPLOC'];
        $this->_isgroupdept = $this->params['ISGROUPDEPT'];
        $this->_isindividualloc = $this->_isgrouploc && $this->params['loc_IR'] == 'true';
        $this->_isindividualdept = $this->_isgroupdept && $this->params['dept_IR'] == 'true';

        // for backward compatibility
        $this->params['irloc'] = $this->params['loc_IR'];
        $this->params['irdept'] = $this->params['dept_IR'];

        $this->_basecurrency = GetBaseCurrency();

        $this->acctFilterQueryArgs = [ "", GetMyCompany() ];

        if (FeatureConfigManagerFactory::getInstance()
            ->isFeatureEnabled("ENABLE_GL_NEW_EXCEL_EXPORT")
        ) {
            $this->setNewExcelFormat(true);
        }

    }

    /**
     * @param bool $showmemorized
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    function &Reporter_Instantiate($showmemorized = false)
    {
        $ok = parent::Reporter_Instantiate($showmemorized);

        if ( ! $ok ) {
            return $ok;
        }

        // Get the saved user preference from DB
        $userPrefs = [];
        $opid = Request::$r->_op;
        $gManagerFactory = Globals::$g->gManagerFactory;
        $memManager = $gManagerFactory->getManager('memorizedreports');
        $res = $memManager->GetUserPref(GetOperation($opid));
        if ( $res ) {
            $userPrefs = $res['PARAMETERS'] ?? [];
        }
        // utilize saved preference params if any from DB
        $this->params = array_merge($userPrefs, $this->params);
        if ( isset($this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES']) && $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] != '' ) {
            $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] =
                $memManager->cleanShowDimensionValues($this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES']);
        }
        $dillFilter = Request::$r->_drillfilter;
        $productLineKey = Request::$r->_productlinekey;
        if ( $dillFilter && ! empty($this->dimensions['productline']) && $productLineKey != '' ) {
            $this->params[$this->dimensions['productline']['path']] = $productLineKey;
        }

        // if SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES is not set it means we are in an old report.
        // in the new report we will have the None value if nothing is selected
        if ( ! isset($this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES']) ) {
            $groupbydept = [ 'dept', 'loc-dept', 'dept-loc' ];
            $groupbyloc = [ 'loc', 'loc-dept', 'dept-loc' ];

            // if location or department are not hidden and not selected for 'group by' we will add then in the value to display
            if ( ! isset($this->params['displayDept']) || $this->params['displayDept'] == false ) {
                if ( ! in_array($this->params['deptlocflag'], $groupbydept) ) {
                    $showDept = 'department__id';
                }
            }
            if ( ! isset($this->params['displayLoc']) || $this->params['displayLoc'] == false ) {
                if ( ! in_array($this->params['deptlocflag'], $groupbyloc) ) {
                    $showLoc = 'location__id';
                }
            }
            /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
            $default = $showDept;
            /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
            $default .= ( $showDept != '' ) ? '#~#' . $showLoc : $showLoc;
            $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] = $default;
        }

        return $ok;
    }

    /**
     * Translate all the old params such as dimension filter clause to have 2 underscores symbols
     */
    private function Translate()
    {
        // For existing memorized reports we must map them to new array with 2 underscores
        if ( isset($this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES']) && ! empty($this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES']) ) {
            $existingParam = explode("#~#", $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES']);

            //reset filters
            $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] = "";
            foreach ( $existingParam as $param ) {
                if ( $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] !== "" ) {
                    $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] .= "#~#";
                }

                // convert only if we don't have 2 underscores
                $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] .= ( isl_strpos($param, "__") !== false ) ?
                    $param : str_replace("_", "__", $param);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return bool
     */
    function DoQuery()
    {
        // Globals that are passed when we drill down to GLLedfer from financial report/trial balance etc..
        $_ac = Request::$r->_ac;

        global $gErr;

        $this->Translate();

        if ( isset($this->params['multiAcc']) ) {
            // backward compatibility, replace enter key with new symbol
            $this->params['multiAcc'] = str_replace("\n", $this->multiAccSeparator, $this->params['multiAcc']);
            $multiAccountlines = explode($this->multiAccSeparator, $this->params['multiAcc']);
            $multiAccountFrom = [];
            $multiAccountTo = [];
            foreach ( $multiAccountlines as $line ) {
                if ( ! empty($line) ) {
                    [ $_frm, $_to ] = explode("->", $line);
                    $multiAccountFrom[] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, trim($_frm));
                    $multiAccountTo[] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, trim($_to));
                }
            }
        }

        // collect the params locally
        $_op = $this->params['op'];
        $_sess = $this->params['sess'];
        $_acct = $this->params['acct'];
        $_acctto = $this->params['acctto'];
        $_acctgrp = $this->params['acctgrp'] ?? '';
        $_allAccts = $this->params['allAccts'];
        $_printing = $this->params['printing'];
        $type = $this->params['oldtype'];
        $_dept = $this->params['dept'];
        $_orig_dept = $this->params['orig_dept'];
        $_loc = $this->params['loc'] ?? [];
        $_orig_loc = $this->params['orig_loc'];
        $_startdate = ( $this->_showmemorized || $this->params['OFFLINEREPORTS'] ) ? $this->params['startdate']
            : FormatDateForStorage($this->params['startdate']);
        $_enddate = ( $this->_showmemorized || $this->params['OFFLINEREPORTS'] ) ? $this->params['enddate']
            : FormatDateForStorage($this->params['enddate']);
        $_asofdate = ( $this->_showmemorized || $this->params['OFFLINEREPORTS'] ) ? $this->params['asofdate']
            : FormatDateForStorage($this->params['asofdate']);
        $_showdetail = $this->params['showdetail'];
        $_showlocation = $this->params['displayLoc'];
        $_showdepartment = $this->params['displayDept'];
        $_deptlocflag = $this->params['deptlocflag'];
        $_showDeptLocActivity = $this->params['showDeptLocActivity'];
        $_showsubtotal = $this->params['showsubtotal'];
        $_selPeriodIndex = $this->params['selPeriodIndex'];
        $_zeroAcctsWTrans = $this->params['zeroAcctsWTrans'];
        $_statAccts = $this->params['statAccts'];
        $_filterTransactions = $this->params['filterTransactions'];
        $_reportingBook = $this->params['reportingBook'];
        $_adjBook = $this->params['ADJUSTMENTBOOK'];
        $_inclRepBook =
            isset($this->params['INCLUDEREPBOOK']) && ( $this->params['INCLUDEREPBOOK'] == 'false' ) ? false : true;
        $_dimComp = $this->params['dimComp'];
        $this->title = $this->params['title'];
        $this->_ytdbal = isset($this->params['ytdbal']) && ( $this->params['ytdbal'] == 'true' ) ? true : false;
        $this->_offsetDetail = $this->params['offsetDetail'];
        $this->params['displayfooteras'] = $this->params['displayfilters'] == 'true' ? 'F' : '';
        $this->params['TXNSTATESELECTION'] = $this->params['TXNSTATESELECTION'] ?? 'posted';
        $cny = GetMyCompany();

        // default the mandatory parameters if the glreport is called from places other than the filters page....
        // egs of other place invocations are stat acc lister / gl account lister / cpa slid-ins etc
        // default the group by option
        $_deptlocflag = $_deptlocflag ? : 'none';

        // default the page orientation to landsacpe
        $this->params['orientation'] = $this->params['orientation'] ? : 'L';

        // reassign the params to the class
        $this->params['deptlocflag'] = $_deptlocflag;
        $this->acctFilterQueryArgs = [ "", $cny ];
        $this->fiscalLoc = '';
        if ( IsMultiEntityCompany() && ! GetContextLocation() ) {
            global $gManagerFactory;
            $locGrpMgr = $gManagerFactory->getManager('locationgroup');
            $members = [];
            foreach ( $_loc ?? [] as $val ) {
                [ $locno ] = explode('--', $val);
                $members[] = $locGrpMgr->GetEntityRecordNo($locEntCache, $locno);
            }

            /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
            if ( ! empty($members) && $locGrpMgr->isHavingCommonFiscalStartMonth($members) ) {
                $this->fiscalLoc = $members[0];
            }
        }

        // set the gl transaction state filter to filter out unposted/posted/all transactions
        if (!empty($this->params['TXNSTATESELECTION'])) {
            $states = array_values(array_intersect(
                explode("#~#", $this->params['TXNSTATEVALUES'] ?? ''),
                array_keys($this->txnStateMap)
            ));
            $this->params['TXNSTATES'] = ($this->params['TXNSTATESELECTION'] === 'unposted')
                ? $states : array_merge([GLBatchManager::getPostedState(true)], $states);
        }


        // begin transaction to keep records in temp table in case
        // given accounts, locations, etc are more than 1000
        XACT_BEGIN("GLLedgerReporter::DoQuery");

        // if startdate/endate is not provided then use the reporting period filter
        if ( $_startdate == '' || $_enddate == '' ) {
            // make sure we have the last selected period, or at least a default
            $repPeriodRecNo = ( (int) $_selPeriodIndex > 0 ) ? $_selPeriodIndex : CurrentReportingPeriod();

            //get period records
            $qry =
                "select record#, name, start_date, end_date, header1, header2, datetype from glbudgettype where cny# = :1 and record# = :2";
            $gPeriodRecords = QueryResult([ $qry, $cny, $repPeriodRecNo ]);

            // Fix for Bug - 13467. Formatting date for storage.
            $asofStorageDate = $_asofdate;

            GetReportingDateRange($gPeriodRecords[0], $asofStorageDate, $gPeriodRecords[0]['START_DATE'],
                                  $gPeriodRecords[0]['END_DATE'], $this->fiscalLoc);
        } else {
            $gPeriodRecords[0]['START_DATE'] = $_startdate;
            $gPeriodRecords[0]['END_DATE'] = $_enddate;
        }

        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $asofStorageDate = $_asofdate;

        [ $_acctno ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($_acct));
        [ $_accttono ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($_acctto));
        //other ids don't allow single quotes, hence we will just fix account group for now.
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $acctgrp = str_replace("'", "\'", $_acctgrp);

        // BUILD ACCT_NO FILTER
        /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
        $this->CalcAccountFilters($_ac, $_acctno, $_accttono, $_acctgrp, $multiAccountFrom, $multiAccountTo);

        if ( $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[0] == '' && $_allAccts == 'true' ) {
            $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[0] = "";
        }

        // add statistical account filter
        if ( ! isset($_statAccts) || $_statAccts == 'false' ) {
            $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[0] .= " and baseaccount.statistical = 'F' ";
        }

        $numArgs = count($this->acctFilterQueryArgs);

        // form the department clause
        $deptclause = $deptclauseForBalance = "";
        if ( ! empty($_dept) ) {
            $deptRecs = $deptIDs = [];
            foreach ( $_dept as $deptIdName ) {
                [ $_deptid ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($deptIdName));
                $deptIDs[] = $_deptid;
            }

            $stmt = [ "", GetMyCompany() ];

            if ( count($deptIDs) > 0 ) {
                if ( $this->params['dept_SUBS'] == 'false' ) {
                    $stmt[0] .= "select record# from departmentmst where cny# = :1  ";
                    $stmt = PrepINClauseStmt($stmt, $deptIDs, 'and dept_no');
                } else {
                    $stmt[0] .= "select record# from departmentmst start with cny# = :1 ";
                    $stmt = PrepINClauseStmt($stmt, $deptIDs, 'and dept_no');
                    $stmt[0] .= " connect by prior record# = parent# and cny# = :1 ";
                }

                $depts = QueryResult($stmt);

                foreach ( $depts as $dept ) {
                    $deptRecs[] = $dept['RECORD#'];
                }

                if ( count($deptRecs) > 0 ) {
                    $deptRecs = array_unique($deptRecs);
                    $countDept = count($deptRecs);
                    if ( $countDept > 1 ) {
                        if ( $countDept > kINClauseLimit ) {
                            $entitytype = 'department';
                            DumpRecsToGlobalTempTable($deptRecs, $tablename, $entitytype);
                            $inClause = "select ENTITYNO from $tablename where entitytype = '" . $entitytype . "'";
                            $deptclause = " and glentry.dept# in ( $inClause ) ";
                            $deptclauseForBalance = " and department.record# in ( $inClause ) ";
                        } else {
                            $inClause = VariablePlaceHolders($numArgs, $countDept);
                            $deptclause = " and glentry.dept# in ( $inClause ) ";
                            $deptclauseForBalance = " and department.record# in ( $inClause ) ";
                            $this->acctFilterQueryArgs = INTACCTarray_merge($this->acctFilterQueryArgs, $deptRecs);
                            $numArgs = count($this->acctFilterQueryArgs);
                        }
                    } else {
                        $deptclause = " and glentry.dept# = :" . $numArgs;
                        $deptclauseForBalance = " and department.record# = :" . $numArgs++;
                        $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[] = $deptRecs[0];
                    }
                } else {
                    // Let's throw an error

                    $gErr->addError('GL-2843', __FILE__ . ':' . __LINE__,
                                    'Invalid value for Department');

                    return false;
                }
            }
        } else if ( $this->params['dept_SUBS'] == 'false' ) {
            $deptclause =
                " and exists (select 1 from departmentmst d where d.cny# = :1 and d.record# = glentry.dept# and d.parent# is null) ";
            $deptclauseForBalance = " and department.parent# is null ";
        }

        // form the location clause
        $locationclause = $locationclauseforBalance = "";
        if ( ! isNullOrBlank($_loc) && Util::countOrZero($_loc) ) {
            $locRecs = $locids = [];
            foreach ( $_loc as $locIdName ) {
                [ $locid ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($locIdName));
                $locids[] = $locid;
            }

            if ( ! isEmptyArray($locids) ) {
                $stmt = [ "", GetMyCompany() ];

                if ( $_filterTransactions == 'SELF' || $this->params['loc_SUBS'] == 'false' ) {
                    $stmt[0] .= "select record# from locationmst where cny# = :1 AND ";
                    $stmt[0] = PrepINClauseStmt($stmt[0], $locids, 'location_no', true, 'dummy', true);
                } else if ( $_filterTransactions == 'CHILDREN' ) {
                    $stmt[0] .= "select record# from locationmst start with cny# = :1 and parentkey in ( ";
                    $stmt[0] .= " select record# from locationmst where cny# = :1 AND ";
                    $stmt[0] = PrepINClauseStmt($stmt[0], $locids, 'location_no', true, 'dummy', true);
                    $stmt[0] .= " ) connect by prior record# = parentkey and cny# = :1 ";
                } else {
                    $stmt[0] .= "select record# from locationmst start with cny# = :1 AND ";
                    $stmt[0] = PrepINClauseStmt($stmt[0], $locids, 'location_no', true, 'dummy', true);
                    $stmt[0] .= " connect by prior record# = parentkey and cny# = :1 ";
                }

                $locs = QueryResult($stmt);
                foreach ( $locs as $loc ) {
                    $locRecs[] = $loc['RECORD#'];
                }

                if ( ! isEmptyArray($locRecs) ) {
                    $locRecs = array_unique($locRecs);
                    $countLocs = count($locRecs);
                    if ( $countLocs > 1 ) {
                        if ( $countLocs > kINClauseLimit ) {
                            $entitytype = 'location';
                            DumpRecsToGlobalTempTable($locRecs, $tablename, $entitytype);
                            $inClause = "select ENTITYNO from $tablename where entitytype = '" . $entitytype . "'";
                            $locationclause = " and glentry.location# in ( $inClause ) ";
                            $locationclauseforBalance = " and location.record#  in ( $inClause ) ";
                        } else {
                            $inClause = VariablePlaceHolders($numArgs, $countLocs);

                            $locationclause = " and glentry.location# in ( $inClause ) ";
                            $locationclauseforBalance = " and location.record#  in ( $inClause ) ";
                            $this->acctFilterQueryArgs = INTACCTarray_merge($this->acctFilterQueryArgs, $locRecs);
                            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                            $numArgs = count($this->acctFilterQueryArgs);
                        }
                    } else {
                        $locationclause = " and glentry.location# = :" . $numArgs;
                        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                        $locationclauseforBalance = " and location.record# = :" . $numArgs++;

                        $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[] = $locRecs[0];
                    }
                } else {
                    // Let's throw an error
                    $gErr->addError('GL-2844', __FILE__ . ':' . __LINE__,
                                    'Invalid value for Location');

                    return false;
                }
            }
        } else if ( $this->params['loc_SUBS'] == 'false' ) {
            $locationclause =
                " and exists (select 1 from locationmst l where l.cny# = :1 and l.record# = glentry.location# and l.parentkey is null) ";
            $locationclauseforBalance = " and location.parentkey is null ";
        }

        global $gManagerFactory;
        $glaccountMgr = $gManagerFactory->getManager('glaccount');

        // set the ReportBy param as requested by user
        // default is A
        $_reportBy = 'A';

        if ( $_deptlocflag == 'none' ) {
            $_reportBy = 'A';
        } else if ( $_deptlocflag == 'dept' ) {
            $_reportBy .= 'D';
        } else if ( $_deptlocflag == 'loc' ) {
            $_reportBy .= 'L';
        } else if ( $_deptlocflag == 'loc-dept' ) {
            $_reportBy .= 'LD';
        } else if ( $_deptlocflag == 'dept-loc' ) {
            $_reportBy .= 'DL';
        }

        //set the currency context, use the first record of location list.
        if ( IsMCMESubscribed() ) {
            //we've already enforced that all locations in the location group should share the same base currency

    /**
     * @param int     $grpComp
     * @param string &$dimensionFilterClause
     */
    function getDimensionComponentClause($grpComp, &$dimensionFilterClause)
    {
        global $gManagerFactory;
        $grpMgr = $gManagerFactory->getManager('glacctgrp');

        $children = $grpMgr->getDimensionMembers($grpComp, $memberType);

        if ( $children !== false ) {
            if ( ! count($children) ) {
                $children = [ '9999999' ];
            }

            $dimInfo = $this->getDimensionGroupTypeInfo($memberType);

            if ( empty($dimInfo) ) {
                $this->handleDisabledDimensionError($grpComp, $memberType);
                return;
            }

            $dimCompClause = ' and ' . $dimInfo['dimdbkey'];

            $stmt = " ";
            $dimensionFilterClause .= PrepINClauseStmt(
                $stmt, $children, $dimCompClause,
                false, "dimgrp_" . $dimInfo['path']
            );

            // adding clue for Reporter::buildDynamicReportQuery() to handle dimComp filters properly
            $this->params['dimComp_dimInfo'] = $dimInfo;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param string $grpComp    VID (name) of the account group
     * @param string $memberType MEMBERTYPE as returned by getDimensionMembers (may be empty when disabled)
     */
    private function handleDisabledDimensionError($grpComp, $memberType)
    {
        global $gErr, $gAccountGroupMap;
        $accountGroupName = $gAccountGroupMap[$grpComp]['NAME'] ?? (string)$grpComp;
        
        if ( empty($memberType) ) {
            $rawStmt = [
                "SELECT name, membertype FROM glacctgrp WHERE cny# = :1 AND name = :2",
                GetMyCompany(),
                $grpComp
            ];
            $rawResult = QueryResult($rawStmt);
            if ( !empty($rawResult) ) {
                $memberType = $rawResult[0]['MEMBERTYPE'] ?? '';
                if ( !empty($rawResult[0]['NAME']) && empty($gAccountGroupMap[$grpComp]['NAME']) ) {
                    $accountGroupName = $rawResult[0]['NAME'];
                }
            }
        }

        // Resolve human-readable dimension name from componentval via getAllDimensions (includes disabled)
        $dimensionName = $memberType;
        $allDimensions = IADimensions::getAllDimensions(true);
        foreach ( $allDimensions as $dimDef ) {
            if ( isset($dimDef['componentval']) && $dimDef['componentval'] === $memberType ) {
                if ( !empty($dimDef['standard']) ) {
                    $dimensionName = !empty($dimDef['internal_label']) ? $dimDef['internal_label'] : $memberType;
                } else {
                    $dimensionName = !empty($dimDef['label']) ? $dimDef['label'] : $memberType;
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        // Fallback: for custom dimensions not in getAllDimensions, look up directly by object def ID
        if ( $dimensionName === $memberType && isl_str_startswith($memberType, 'CUSTDIM_') ) {
            $objDefId = (int) isl_substr($memberType, 8);
            if ( $objDefId > 0 ) {
                include_once 'Pt_DataObjectDefManager.cls';
                $objDef = Pt_DataObjectDefManager::getByIdNoCache($objDefId);
                if ( $objDef !== null ) {
                    $dimensionName = $objDef->getSingularName();
                }
            }
        }
        $gErr->addIAError(
            'GL-3610',
            __FILE__ . ':' . __LINE__,
            null,
            ['DIMENSION_NAME' => $dimensionName, 'ACCOUNT_GROUP_NAME' => $accountGroupName]
        );
    }

    /**

    function getDimensionGroupTypeInfo($type)
    {
        $dimInfo = [];
        $repDims = $this->GetReportDimensions();
        foreach ( $repDims as $name => $params ) {
            if ( isl_strstr($type, $params['internal_label'] ?? $params['label'])

                $dimInfo = $params;
                $dimInfo['dimName'] = $name;
                break;
            }
        }

        return $dimInfo;
    }

    /**
     * @param string     $_ac
     * @param string     $_acctno
     * @param string     $_accttono
     * @param string     $_acctgrp
     * @param string[][] $multiAccountFrom
     * @param string[][] $multiAccountTo
     */
    function CalcAccountFilters($_ac, $_acctno, $_accttono, $_acctgrp, $multiAccountFrom, $multiAccountTo)
    {
        $acctFilter = "";
        $numArgs = count($this->acctFilterQueryArgs);
        if ( Util::php7eqEmptyStr($numArgs) || $numArgs <= 1 ) {
            $numArgs = 2;
        }

        // drill down from other reports
        if ( $_ac != '' ) {
            $acctFilter .= " and baseaccount.record# = :" . $numArgs++;
            $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[] = $_ac;
        }

        // account ranges
        $accRangeQry = [];
        $accRangeQry[0] = 'select record# from baseaccount where cny#=:1 ';
        $accRangeQry[] = GetMyCompany();

        if ( ! empty($multiAccountFrom) && ! empty($multiAccountTo) ) {
            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
            $ctr = 0;
            $cnt = Util::countOrZero($multiAccountFrom) - 1;
            $this->isMultiAccount = true;
            $this->multiAccontCaseStatment = "( case";
            $accRangeQry[0] .= " and (";
            for ( $ctr = 0; $ctr <= $cnt; $ctr++ ) {
                $__from = $multiAccountFrom[$ctr][0];
                $__to = $multiAccountTo[$ctr][0];
               
                $this->multiAccontCaseStatment .= " WHEN (acct_no >= :". $numArgs++ ." AND acct_no <= :". $numArgs++ ." ) THEN " . $ctr;
                $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[] = $__from;
                $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[] = $__to;
               
                $accRangeQry[0] .= " (baseaccount.acct_no >= :" . count($accRangeQry);
                $accRangeQry[] = $__from;
                $accRangeQry[0] .= " and baseaccount.acct_no <= :" . count($accRangeQry);
                $accRangeQry[] = $__to;

                if ($ctr === $cnt) {
                    $accRangeQry[0] .= " ) ";
                } else {
                    $accRangeQry[0] .= " ) or";
                }
            }

            $accRangeQry[0] .= " ) ";
            $this->multiAccontCaseStatment .= " END) LVL ,";
        }

        if ( $_acctno != '' || $_accttono != '' || $this->isMultiAccount ) {
            if ( $_acctno != '' ) {
                $accRangeQry[0] .= " and acct_no >= :" . count($accRangeQry);
                $accRangeQry[] = $_acctno;
            }
            if ( $_accttono != '' ) {
                $accRangeQry[0] .= " and acct_no <= :" . count($accRangeQry);
                $accRangeQry[] = $_accttono;
            }
            $accRangeRes = QueryResult($accRangeQry);
            if ( count($accRangeRes) ) {
                $acctFilterArray = $this->acctFilterQueryArgs;
                $accts = [];
                foreach ( $accRangeRes as $res ) {
                    $accts[] = $res['RECORD#'];
                    $numArgs++;
                }

                if ( count($accts) <= kINClauseLimit ) {
                    $this->acctFilterQueryArgs = INTACCTarray_merge($this->acctFilterQueryArgs, $accts);
                }
                $acctFilterArray = PrepINClauseStmt(
                    $acctFilterArray,
                    $accts,
                    " and baseaccount.record#",
                    true,
                    "accts",
                    false,
                    null);
                $acctFilter .= $acctFilterArray[0];
            } else {
                $acctFilter .= " and baseaccount.record# = :" . $numArgs++;
                $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[] = -99999;
            }
        }
        if ( ! empty($_acctgrp) ) {
            $industry = GetMyIndustryType();
            $cny = GetMyCompany();
            if ( isl_strstr($_acctgrp, 'System_') === false ) {
                $agGrpQry = "select record# from glacctgrp where name = :2 and howcreated = 'U' and cny# = :1";
                $agRecordNo = QueryResult([ $agGrpQry, $cny, $_acctgrp ]) ? : null;
                if ( ! empty($agRecordNo) ) {
                    $agRecordNo = $agRecordNo[0]['RECORD#'];
                }

                $agMembersQry = "select baseaccount.record#
                        from glacctgrpranges ga,
                             baseaccount
                        where baseaccount.cny# = ga.cny#
                          and baseaccount.acct_no between ga.rangefrom and ga.rangeto
                          and ga.cny# = :1
                          and (ga.parentkey in (select child#
                                                from glacctgrpmembers
                                                start with parent# = :2 and cny# = :1
                                                connect by prior child# = parent# and cny# = :1) or ga.parentkey = :2) ";
                if ( ! empty($industry) ) {
                    $agMembersQry .= " union all
                            select baseaccount.record#
                            from coacatmembers ga,
                                 baseaccount
                            where baseaccount.cny# = ga.cny#
                              and ga.cny# = :1
                              and baseaccount.categorykey = ga.categorykey
                              and (ga.parent# in (select child#
                                                  from glacctgrpmembers
                                                  start with parent# = :2 and cny# = :1
                                                  connect by prior child# = parent# and cny# = :1) or ga.parent# = :2)";
                }
            } else {
                $agGrpQry = "select record# from iaglacctgrp where name = :1 and industrycode = :2";
                $agRecordNo = QueryResult([ $agGrpQry, $_acctgrp, $industry ]) ? : null;
                if ( ! empty($agRecordNo) ) {
                    $agRecordNo = $agRecordNo[0]['RECORD#'];
                }

                $agMembersQry = "select baseaccount.record#
                                        from iacoacatmembers ga,
                                             coacat cat,
                                             iacoacat iacat,
                                             baseaccount
                                        where 
                                            iacat.record# = ga.categorykey
                                          and iacat.name = cat.name
                                          and cat.cny# = baseaccount.cny#
                                          and baseaccount.categorykey = cat.record#
                                          and baseaccount.cny# = :1
                                          and (ga.parent# in (select child#
                                                              from iaglacctgrpmembers
                                                              start with parent# = :2
                                                              connect by prior child# = parent#) or
                                               ga.parent# = :2)";
            }
            $agMembersRes = QueryResult([ $agMembersQry, $cny, $agRecordNo ]) ? : [];
            $agMembers = array_column($agMembersRes, 'RECORD#');

            // if any members found, add it to the IN clause
            if ( ! empty($agMembers) ) {
                $acctFilter .= PrepINClauseStmt("", $agMembers, " and baseaccount.record# ");
            } else {
                // possible case where an account group has a range that is not a valid member
                // in this case we cannot add IN clause with empty expression (), instead adding a condition that
                // will be always false - this will purposefully FAIL
                $acctFilter .= " and baseaccount.record# is null ";
            }
        }

        $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[0] = $acctFilter;
    }

    /**
     * This will build the select clause depending on the dimensions field the user has choosen
     * to put inside the report
     *
     * @param bool $alias
     *
     * @return string
     */
    private function GetSubTransSelectShowDimQuery($alias = true)
    {
        // We will add dimensions select only if the user chooses to display the value.
        // This will optimize our query time
        $showdimensions = explode('#~#', $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] ?? '');
        $dimcount = ! empty($showdimensions) ? count($showdimensions) : 0;

        $select = '';
        for ( $i = 0; $i < $dimcount; $i++ ) {
            if ( $showdimensions[$i] == '' || $showdimensions[$i] == 'None' ) {
                continue;
            }
            [ $dimentity, $dimvalue ] = explode('__', $showdimensions[$i]);
            $dimParams = $this->dimensions[$dimentity];

            $dimAlias = $dimentity;
            if ( $dimParams['isplatform'] ) {
                $dimAlias = 'CUSTDIM_' . $dimParams['objid'];
                $dimvalue = "__$dimvalue";
            }

            $select .= ', gl_info.' . $dimAlias . $dimvalue;
            if ( $alias ) {
                $select .= ' as ' . $dimAlias . $dimvalue;
            }
            $select .= ' ';
        }

        return $select;
    }

    /**
     * This function will build the query clauses depending on the dimensions field the user has choosen
     * to put inside the report
     *
     * @param string $select
     * @param string $from
     * @param string $where
     * @param string $alias
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    private function BuildShowDimQuery(&$select, &$from, &$where, $alias = 'glentry')
    {
        // We will add dimensions select and join only if the user chooses to display the value.
        // This will optimize our query time
        $showdimensions = explode('#~#', $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES'] ?? '');
        $dimcount = ! empty($showdimensions) ? count($showdimensions) : 0;

        for ( $i = 0; $i < $dimcount; $i++ ) {
            if ( $showdimensions[$i] == '' || $showdimensions[$i] == 'None' ) {
                continue;
            }
            [ $dimentity, $dimvalue ] = explode('__', $showdimensions[$i]);
            $params = $this->dimensions[$dimentity];

            if ( ! $params['standard'] ) {
                continue;
            }

            // For employee we have to map with the contact table
            if ( $dimentity == 'employee' ) {
                if ( $dimvalue == 'id' ) {
                    $select .= ',employee.employeeid as employeeid';
                } else {
                    $select .= ',contact.name as employeename';
                    $where .= ' and contact.cny# (+) = employee.cny# and contact.record# (+) = employee.contactkey';
                    $from .= ',contact contact';
                }

                // we will add the from and where condition only if not already added
                // oracle will not like us to declare it 2 times
                $tmpfrom = ',employeemst employee';
                if ( isl_strpos($from, $tmpfrom) === false ) {
                    $from .= $tmpfrom;
                }

                $tmpwhere = ' and employee.cny# (+) = ' . $alias . '.cny# and employee.record# (+) = ' . $alias
                            . '.employeedimkey';
                if ( isl_strpos($where, $tmpwhere) === false ) {
                    $where .= $tmpwhere;
                }
            } else {  // For other dimensions we will select name and ID

                if ( $dimvalue == 'id' ) {
                    $select .= ',' . $dimentity . '.' . $params['dimfkid'] . ' as ' . $dimentity . 'id';
                } else {
                    if ( $dimentity == 'department' ) {
                        $select .= ',' . $dimentity . '.title as ' . $dimentity . 'name';
                    } else {
                        $select .= ',' . $dimentity . '.name as ' . $dimentity . 'name';
                    }
                }

                // department and location are already in the query. No need to join again.
                if ( $dimentity != 'department' && $dimentity != 'location' ) {
                    // we will add the from and where condition only if not already added
                    // oracle will not like us to declare it 2 times
                    $tmpfrom = ',' . $params['table'] . ' ' . $dimentity;
                    if ( isl_strpos($from, $tmpfrom) === false ) {
                        $from .= $tmpfrom;
                    }

                    $tmpwhere = ' and ' . $alias . '.cny# = ' . $dimentity . '.cny# (+) ' . ' and ' . $alias . '.'
                                . $params['dimdbkey'] . '=' . $dimentity . '.' . 'record# (+) ';
                    if ( isl_strpos($where, $tmpwhere) === false ) {
                        $where .= $tmpwhere;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $ok = parent::buildDynamicReportQuery($select, $from, $where, 'glentry');

        return $ok;
    }

    /**
     * @param bool   $detailedReport flag for the detailed query to fire
     * @param bool   $showSubTotal   flag to identify whether subtotals is requested or not - currently not used
     * @param string $deptclause     department filter, if selected by user
     * @param string $locationclause location filter, if selected by user

    function _getSryReportQuery(                          $detailedReport,

    {
        $acctSubSql = $this->acctFilterQueryArgs[0];

        // period records is part of class attribute.
        $gPeriodRecords = $this->_gPeriodRecords;

        }

        $args = [];
        // initialize query stmt array
        if ( count($this->acctFilterQueryArgs) > 1 ) {
            $args = $this->acctFilterQueryArgs;
        }

        $args[0] = "";
        $args[1] = GetMyCompany();

        $numArgs = count($args);

        // no need to post increment for $numArgs as we are not using it further
        $entryDateFilter =
            " and ( glentry.entry_date between to_date(:" . $numArgs++ . ",'mm/dd/yyyy')  and to_date(:" . $numArgs++
            . ",'mm/dd/yyyy') ) ";
        $args[] = $gPeriodRecords[0]['START_DATE'];
        $args[] = $gPeriodRecords[0]['END_DATE'];

        // we are going to reuse the $args since most of the query args are same
        // and this we enforce bind variable for both the queries
        // since we need to add the bootClause we will make a copy of srgs and bind the var
        $stmt = $args;

        $bookClause = "";
        if ( ! empty($bookArr) ) {
            // using PrepINClauseStmt 
            if ( $isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable ) {
                $bookClause = PrepINClauseStmt('', $bookArr, " and glentry.bookid ", true, 'dummy', true);
            } else {
                if (FeatureConfigManagerFactory::getInstance()
                    ->isFeatureEnabled("ENABLE_GL_REPORT_BASEJOURNAL_INCLAUSE")
                ) {
                    $jrnlQuery = "select baj.record#
                    from basejournal baj, bookjournals bj
                    where baj.cny# = :1 and
                    baj.cny# = bj.cny# and
                    bj.journalkey = baj.record#";

                    $jrnlQuery = PrepINClauseStmt(
                        $jrnlQuery, array_unique($bookArr), " and bj.bookid ",
                        true, 'dummy', true
                    );
                     $jrnlRecords = QueryResult(array($jrnlQuery, GetMyCompany())) ?: [];
                    foreach ($jrnlRecords as $record) {
                        $jrnlKeys[$record['RECORD#']] = true;
                    }

                    $bookClause = PrepINClauseStmt(
                        " ", array_keys($jrnlKeys), " and basejournal.record# ", true, 'dummy', true
                    );
                } else {
                    $bookClause = " and exists (select 1 from bookjournals bkj " .
                        " where bkj.cny# = :1 and bkj.journalkey = basejournal.record# ";
                    $bookClause = PrepINClauseStmt($bookClause, $bookArr, " and bkj.bookid ", true, 'dummy', true);
                    $bookClause .= " ) ";
                }
            }
        }

        $docCol = "glentry.document";

        // While running report in detial mode with reference column,then fetch ref number if doc number is empty for JE
        if ( $this->params['showdetail'] == 'D' && $this->params['docColumnValue'] == 'R' ) {
            $docCol = "nvl(glentry.document, glbatch.referenceno)";
        }

        $dimKeys = IADimensions::getAllDimensionKeys();

        $selectDims = "";
        foreach ( $dimKeys as $dimKey ) {
            $selectDims .= "glentry.$dimKey, ";
        }

        // we will keep locname and deptname in the query for all the existing
        // code will keep working. We will select again ID and Name under different alias if the user select it in the mulipick
        // Array where similar columns are added
        $glEntryCommonSelect = [
            'glentry.record#', 'glentry.entry_date', 'glentry.description', 'glentry.account#', 'glentry.location#',

        $userID = GetMyUserid();
        // There are more values for new data storage hence key index for consglentry and value for glentry table
        // The reason because cannot have multiple key as ''

            $glReportSelectArray = array_keys($selectArray);

                $acctSubSql

                 $dimensionFilter;

        $orderby = " ORDER BY " . implode(', ', $glReportOrderArray);

        // Add the clauses to select dimensions values
        $this->BuildShowDimQuery($select, $from, $where);

        // In the new table, debit, credit, trx_debit and trx_credit all stored in one row whereas in glentry system
        // creates separate entries for debit and credit.
        // To display same way, we need to have union debit and credit for new storage
        // No need to order the query as it is taken care by xsl template
        // GL report Records need to be orderd properly to match with glentry
        if ( $isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable ) {
            $stmt[0] = "select * from (
                            WITH glentry as ( $select $from $where )

                            glentry where debit != 0
                         UNION ALL
                            SELECT credit as amount, trx_credit as trx_amount, -1 AS tr_type, 
                            glentry.* FROM glentry where credit != 0

        $transRecords = QueryResult($stmt);

            // no need to run this query if consolidation books are filtered
            if ( ! $isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable ) {
                $wselect = ' SELECT glentry.cny#, prglentryresolve.prentrykey, prglentryresolve.cbprentrykey, prglentryresolve.description prgldesc,

						round(prglentryresolve.amount,2) as prglamount, round(prglentryresolve.trx_amount,2) as prgltrxamount,
						glentry.location# location#, location.location_no locname, glentry.dept# dept#,

                    =
                    ' FROM prglentryresolve, glentry, glbatchmst glbatch, locationmst location, departmentmst department, baseaccount ';

                // GRADY GL DETAIL CASH BASIS REPORT - Modified by: aps (next 1 lines)                        
                $this->setBillLines();

                $wwhere = " WHERE 
						glentry.cny# = :1
						and prglentryresolve.cny# = glentry.cny# 
						and prglentryresolve.glentrykey = glentry.record# 
						--
						and baseaccount.cny# = glentry.cny#

						and glentry.amount != 0 $entryDateFilter
						--
						and glbatch.cny# = glentry.cny# 
						and glbatch.record# = glentry.batch# 
						and glbatch.modulekey != '2.GL' 
                        and " . GLBatchManager::getPostStateQryFilter('glbatch', true, 'glentry') . "
						and location.cny# (+) = glentry.cny# 
						and location.record# (+) = glentry.location# 
						and department.cny# (+) = glentry.cny# 
						and department.record# (+) = glentry.dept# " .

                          $locationclause .
                          $dimensionFilter;

                // Add the clauses to select dimensions values for sub trans
                $this->BuildShowDimQuery($wselect, $wfrom, $wwhere);

                // We need to get all the select values for the group by and select statement here
                // to add them in the XML
                $dimselect = $this->GetSubTransSelectShowDimQuery();
                $dimgroupby = $this->GetSubTransSelectShowDimQuery(false);

                $args[0]
                    = " WITH gl_info as (" . $wselect . $wfrom . $wwhere . ") 
					SELECT
						glentryrechash, 
						glbatchdate,
						glbatchrechash,
						prrecord.record#,
						prrecord.prbatchkey,
						prrecord.whencreated,
						prrecord.parentpayment,
						prrecord.entity,
						prrecord.recordtype, 
						prrecord.recordid, 
						prrecord.docnumber,
						prrecord.paymethodkey,
                        prrecord.locationkey subownerloc,
						financialaccount.type finaccttype, 
						(case when transferlink.paymentkey is not null then 1 else 0 end) as isfundstxfer, 
						gl_info.account#,
						gl_info.dept#,
						deptname,
						gl_info.location#,
						locname,
						nvl(nvl(gl_info.prgldesc, prentry.description), prrecord.description) description,
						gl_info.currency,
						max(tr_type) as tr_type, 
						sum(prglamount) as amount,
						sum(prgltrxamount) as trx_amount
						$dimselect
						$this->selforbilllines
					FROM 
						gl_info,
						prentry, 
						prrecordmst prrecord,
						transferlink, 
						financialaccount
					WHERE  
						prentry.cny# (+) = :1 
						and prentry.cny# (+) = gl_info.cny#
						and prentry.record# (+) = gl_info.prentrykey
						and prrecord.cny# (+) = prentry.cny#

						and financialaccount.entity (+) = prrecord.financialentity

					group by

						prrecord.recordid,

                if ( $this->_mapEntityNamesFromQResult($subTransRecords, $entNameMap) ) {

            // In the case of consolidation book, consider book source id as well.
            $this->params['isConsolidationBook'] = GLBookManager::IsConsolidationBook($this->params['reportingBook']);
            // When running report for new data storage then we don't need journal symbol and sourcebookid map
            // we can achieve with the help of bookid

            if ( $this->params['isConsolidationBook'] && count($this->_gTranscationRecs) > 0 ) {

                }
            }

            // In Detail mode, Trx amount drill-down is enabled for consolidation books.
            // In the case for tier consolidation books, for the roll-up entity, system should pick data from its
            // subsidiary book and entity. In this case, reporting book is no longer ACCRUAL, it will be subsidiary book
            // How to achieve it? 
            // 1. Get all the entities in book excluding parent and elimination entities
            // 2. Check each entities are associated with any book
            // 3. Create map between entities and other books in the same structure
            // We should cache entities and book mapping only for tier consolidation books
            if ($isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable
                && GCBookManager::isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable(
                    $this->params['reportingBook']
                )
            ) {
                $this->cacheEntityBookMapForTier($this->params['reportingBook']);
            }
        }

        //When we have REPOTINGACCOUNTSET, Process the Result SET for DoMap()
        if ( ! empty($this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET']) ) {
            $this->DoPreMapProcessing();
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @param string $bookID
     */
    private function cacheEntityBookMapForTier($bookID)
    {
        // 1. Get all the entities in book excluding parent and elimination entities
        // 2. Check each entities are associated with any book
        // 3. Create map between entities and other books in the same structure
        $gcBookMgr = Globals::$g->gManagerFactory->getManager('gcbook');
        // Do not need parent entity
        $structureKey = '';
        $bookEntities = $gcBookMgr->getChildEntitiesByCSNBook($bookID, false, $structureKey);
        $bookEntityMap = $gcBookMgr->getAllSubsidiaryBooksByEntities($bookEntities, $structureKey);

        foreach ( $bookEntityMap as $val ) {
            $this->entityBookMapForTier[$val['PARENTENTITYKEY']] = $val['BOOKID'];
        }
    }

    /**
     * This funcion will take care of Converting the Result to Reporting Accounts
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    public function DoPreMapProcessing()
    {
        //If there are some possible translations at all.
        if ( $this->_nativeToRptKeyedAcs != ''
             && isset($this->_nativeToRptKeyedAcs)
        ) {
            //Convert the Transactions
            $TrxCnt = count($this->_gTranscationRecs);
            if ( $TrxCnt > 0 ) {
                foreach ( $this->_gTranscationRecs as $key => $val ) {
                    $baseAcctKey = $val['ACCOUNT#'];
                    if ( $this->_nativeToRptKeyedAcs[$baseAcctKey] != '' ) {
                        $this->_gTranscationRecs[$key]['ACCOUNT#'] =
                            $this->_nativeToRptKeyedAcs[$baseAcctKey]['REPORTINGACKEY'];
                    }
                }
            }

            //Convert the Sub Transactions
            if ( $this->_gSubTransCount > 0 ) {
                foreach ( $this->_gSubTranscationRecs as $entrykey => $entries ) {
                    foreach ( $entries as $key => $entry ) {
                        /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                        $baseAcctKey = $val['ACCOUNT#'];
                        if ( $this->_nativeToRptKeyedAcs[$baseAcctKey] != '' ) {
                            $this->_gSubTranscationRecs[$entrykey][$key]['ACCOUNT#'] =
                                $this->_nativeToRptKeyedAcs[$baseAcctKey]['REPORTINGACKEY'];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        //eppp_p($this->_gTranscationRecs);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @param string[][]  $qRes
     * @param string[]   &$entNameMap
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    function _mapEntityNamesFromQResult($qRes, &$entNameMap)
    {
        global $gErr;

        if ( empty($qRes) ) {
            return true;
        }

        $typeMap = $entNameMap = [];

        foreach ( $qRes as $rec ) {
            if ( $rec["ENTITY"] ) {
                $typeMap[isl_substr($rec["ENTITY"], 0, 1)][] = $rec["ENTITY"];
            }
        }

        $cvTable = [ 'C' => 'customer', 'V' => 'vendor' ];
        foreach ( $typeMap as $chr => $entities ) {
            if ( in_array($chr, [ 'C', 'V' ]) ) {
                $stmt = [ "
					SELECT entity, name 
					FROM $cvTable[$chr]
					WHERE cny# = :1",
                          GetMyCompany() ];
            } else if ( $chr == 'E' ) {
                $stmt = [ "
					SELECT e.entity, c.printas name 
					FROM employee e, contact c	
					WHERE e.cny# = :1 and c.cny# = :1 and c.record# = e.contactkey",
                          GetMyCompany() ];
            } else {
                continue;
            }
            $stmt = PrepINClauseStmt($stmt, array_unique($entities), " and entity ");
            foreach ( QueryResult($stmt) as $rec ) {
                $entNameMap[$rec["ENTITY"]] = $rec["NAME"];
            }
        }

        return ! $gErr->hasErrors();
    }

                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['cr'] = '';
                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['nc'] = '';
                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['bal'] = '';
                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['fwd'] = $acctTotal;
                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['level'] = '';
                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['recordno'] = $acctDet['RECORD#'];
                    /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                    $transCount = 0;

                    if ( $locSetValue && ! $deptSetValue ) {
                        // grouping is reqd by dept or loc
                        foreach ( $locationMap as $locationRec => $locDet ) {
                             $transCount = countArray(($gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] ?? [])[$locationRec] ?? []);
                            // we need to set the attributes befor adding another array
                            // else the xml string creation will fail!!

                            $dummyArray['CHILDPATH'] = $locDet['CHILDPATH'];
                            $dummyArray['fullname'] = $locDet['FULLNAME'];
                            $dummyArray['db'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['cr'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['nc'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['bal'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['level'] = $locDet['LVL'];
                            $dummyArray['fwd'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['recordno'] = $locDet['RECORDNO'];
                            // added this new one so that the child transactions precede the parent's
                            // else the trans array will be added first !!
                            $dummyArray['element2'] = null; // ['element2'][0]['element2'][0]['element2'][0] = []
                            $dummyArray['other'] = null;
                            eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]" . $locDet["PATH"] . " = \$dummyArray;");

                            // we are done with dummy array .. discard it
                            unset($dummyArray);

                            if ( $transCount != 0 ) {
                                // we have now set the element attributes along with the hierarchy
                                // we need to add the transactions to it
                                foreach ( $gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]][$locationRec] as $transDetails ) {
                                    // get the reworked transaction details
                                    $tempArray = $this->getReworkedTrans($transDetails, $_showdetail, $_showsubtotal,
                                                                         $ctaAdjAcctKey, $gBookidJrnlSymbols, $verb);
                                    /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                                    foreach ( $tempArray as $tempTranDetails ) {

                                             . "['trans'][] = \$tempTranDetails;");
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                        // add the attributes of other array
                        // this is the place holder for those transaction for which no loc/dept is present
                        $otherArray = [];
                        $otherArray['level'] = '';
                        /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                        $otherArray['name'] = $elementName;
                        $otherArray['db'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['cr'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['nc'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['bal'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['fwd'] = '0';
                        $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['other'][0] = $otherArray;

                        // we are done with other array .. discard it
                        unset($otherArray);

                        $otherTransCount = countArray(($gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] ?? [])[''] ?? []);
                        if ( $otherTransCount != 0 ) {
                            // we have now set the element attributes along with the hierarchy
                            // we need to add the transactions to it which belong to the account and not to any element2
                            foreach ( $gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]][''] as $transDetails ) {
                                // get the reworked transaction details
                                $tempArray =
                                    $this->getReworkedTrans($transDetails, $_showdetail, $_showsubtotal, $ctaAdjAcctKey,
                                                            $gBookidJrnlSymbols, $verb);

                    } else if ( $locSetValue && $deptSetValue ) {
                        // grouping is reqd by dept-loc or loc-dept

                            // we need to set the attributes befor adding another array
                            // else the xml string creation will fail!!
                            $dummyArray = [];
                            $dummyArray['id'] = $locDet['ELEMENTID'];
                            $dummyArray['CHILDPATH'] = $locDet['CHILDPATH'];
                            $dummyArray['fullname'] = $locDet['FULLNAME'];
                            $dummyArray['db'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['cr'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['nc'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['bal'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['level'] = $locDet['LVL'];
                            $dummyArray['fwd'] = '0';
                            $dummyArray['recordno'] = $locDet['RECORDNO'];
                            // added this new one so that the child transactions precede the parent's
                            // else the trans array will be added first !!
                            eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]" . $locDet["PATH"] . " = \$dummyArray;");

                            // we are done with dummy array .. discard it
                            unset($dummyArray);

                            // the following array takes care of transactions that do not belong to any element2 (loc)
