                            $otherArray['level'] = '';
                            /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                            $otherArray['name'] = $elementName;
                            $otherArray['db'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['cr'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['nc'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['bal'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['fwd'] = '0';
                            $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['other'][0] = $otherArray;

                            // we are done with other array .. discard it
                            unset($otherArray);

                            // the the complete hierarchy for the other element
                            // NOTE in the beginning this map is set conditionally 
                            // so actually it would have either department or location detail as the case may be
                            foreach ( $departmentMap as $departmentRec => $deptDet ) {
                                // we need to set the attributes befor adding another array
                                // else the xml string creation will fail!!
                                $dummyArray = [];
                                $dummyArray['id'] = $deptDet['ELEMENTID'];
                                $dummyArray['CHILDPATH'] = $deptDet['CHILDPATH'];
                                $dummyArray['fullname'] = $deptDet['FULLNAME'];
                                $dummyArray['db'] = '0';
                                $dummyArray['cr'] = '0';
                                $dummyArray['nc'] = '0';
                                $dummyArray['bal'] = '0';
                                $dummyArray['level'] = $deptDet['LVL'];
                                $dummyArray['fwd'] = '0';
                                $dummyArray['recordno'] = $deptDet['RECORDNO'];
                                // added this new one so that the child transactions precede the parent's
                                // else the trans array will be added first !!
                                $dummyArray['element3'] = null;

                                eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]" . $locDet["PATH"] . $deptDet["PATH"]
                                     . " = \$dummyArray;");
                                eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]['other'][0]" . $deptDet["PATH"] . " = \$dummyArray;");

                                // we are done with dummy array .. discard it
                                unset($dummyArray);

                                $transCount =
                                    countArray((($gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] ?? [])[$locationRec] ?? [])[$departmentRec] ?? []);
                                if ( $transCount != 0 ) {
                                    // we have now set the element attributes along with the hierarchy
                                    // we need to add the transactions to it
                                    foreach ( $gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]][$locationRec][$departmentRec] as $transDetails ) {
                                        // get the reworked transaction details
                                        $tempArray =
                                            $this->getReworkedTrans($transDetails, $_showdetail, $_showsubtotal,
                                                                    $ctaAdjAcctKey, $gBookidJrnlSymbols, $verb);
                                        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                                        foreach ( $tempArray as $tempTranDetails ) {
                                            eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]" . $locDet['PATH'] . $deptDet['PATH']
                                                 . "['trans'][] = \$tempTranDetails;");
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                $transElement3Count =
                                    countArray((($gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] ?? [])[''] ?? [])[$departmentRec] ?? []);
                                if ( $transElement3Count != 0 ) {
                                    // we have now set the element attributes along with the hierarchy
                                    // we need to add the transactions to it
                                    foreach ( $gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]][''][$departmentRec] as $transDetails ) {
                                        // get the reworked transaction details
                                        $tempArray =
                                            $this->getReworkedTrans($transDetails, $_showdetail, $_showsubtotal,
                                                                    $ctaAdjAcctKey, $gBookidJrnlSymbols, $verb);
                                        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                                        foreach ( $tempArray as $tempTranDetails ) {
                                            eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]['other'][0]" . $deptDet['PATH']
                                                 . "['trans'][] = \$tempTranDetails;");
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            } // end of element 3 loop (department loop)

                            // this array takes care of transactions that do not belong to any loc or dept
                            $otherArray = [];
                            $otherArray['level'] = '';
                            /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                            $otherArray['name'] = $element2Name;
                            $otherArray['db'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['cr'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['nc'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['bal'] = '0';
                            $otherArray['fwd'] = '0';
                            eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]" . $locDet["PATH"] . "['other'][0] = \$otherArray;");

                            // we are done with other array .. discard it
                            unset($otherArray);

                            $otherTransCount = countArray((($gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] ?? [])[$locationRec] ?? [])[''] ?? []);
                            if ( $otherTransCount != 0 ) {
                                // we have now set the element attributes along with the hierarchy
                                // we need to add the transactions to it which belong to the account and not to any element2
                                foreach ( $gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]][$locationRec][''] as $transDetails ) {
                                    // get the reworked transaction details
                                    $tempArray = $this->getReworkedTrans($transDetails, $_showdetail, $_showsubtotal,
                                                                         $ctaAdjAcctKey, $gBookidJrnlSymbols, $verb);
                                    /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                                    foreach ( $tempArray as $tempTranDetails ) {
                                        eval("\$tempTransArray['acct'][0]" . $locDet['PATH']
                                             . "['other'][0]['trans'][] = \$tempTranDetails;");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } // end of element 2 loop (location loop)

                        // this array takes care of transactions that do not belong to any loc or dept
                        $otherArray = [];
                        $otherArray['level'] = '';
                        /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                        $otherArray['name'] = $element2Name;
                        $otherArray['db'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['cr'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['nc'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['bal'] = '0';
                        $otherArray['fwd'] = '0';
                        $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['other'][0]['other']['0'] = $otherArray;

                        // we are done with other array .. discard it
                        unset($otherArray);

                        $otherTransCount = countArray((($gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] ?? [])[''] ?? [])[''] ?? []);
                        if ( $otherTransCount != 0 ) {
                            // we have now set the element attributes along with the hierarchy
                            // we need to add the transactions to it which belong to the account and not to any element2
                            foreach ( $gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]][''][''] as $transDetails ) {
                                // get the reworked transaction details
                                $tempArray =
                                    $this->getReworkedTrans($transDetails, $_showdetail, $_showsubtotal, $ctaAdjAcctKey,
                                                            $gBookidJrnlSymbols, $verb);
                                foreach ( $tempArray as $tempTranDetails ) {
                                    if ( Request::$r->_type == '_csv'
                                         || ( isset($this->params['offreporttype'])
                                              && $this->params['offreporttype'] == '_csv' ) ) {
                                        $tempTranDetails['date'] = FormatDateForDisplay($tempTranDetails['date']);
                                        $tempTranDetails['docdate'] = FormatDateForDisplay($tempTranDetails['docdate']);
                                    }
                                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['other'][0]['other'][0]['trans'][] = $tempTranDetails;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        // no grouping by loc or dept required
                        $transCount = countArray($gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] ?? []);
                        if ( $transCount != 0 ) {
                            // transactions are present for the account
                            foreach ( $gTranscationRecs[$acctDet["RECORD#"]] as $transDetails ) {
                                // get the reworked transaction details
                                $tempArray =
                                    $this->getReworkedTrans($transDetails, $_showdetail, $_showsubtotal, $ctaAdjAcctKey,
                                                            $gBookidJrnlSymbols, $verb);
                                foreach ( $tempArray as $tempTranDetails ) {
                                    if ( Request::$r->_type == '_csv'
                                         || ( isset($this->params['offreporttype'])
                                              && $this->params['offreporttype'] == '_csv' ) ) {
                                        $tempTranDetails['date'] = FormatDateForDisplay($tempTranDetails['date']);
                                        $tempTranDetails['docdate'] = FormatDateForDisplay($tempTranDetails['docdate']);
                                    }
                                    $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['trans'][] = $tempTranDetails;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // form the totals / running balances
                    $thisdb = 0;
                    $thiscr = 0;
                    $thisbal = 0;
                    $firsttrans = true;
                    $on_other = false;
                    $other_level_bal = 0;
                    $element2Inf = '';
                    $element3Inf = '';
                    /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                    $thisFwd = '0';
                    $accrecno = $acctDet["recordno"] ?? null;
                    $thisFwd = $acctDet["fwd"] ?? null;

                    if ( $_showdetail == 'D' && ! empty($tempTransArray['acct'][0]['trans']) ) {
                        // apply sorting by 'date', 'doc' and 'locname'
                        // apply sorting by 'date', 'doc' and locname'
                        $this->GetSortMap($tempTransArray, $_showsubtotal);
                    }

                    $this->BuildReportTotals(
                        $tempTransArray, $_zeroAcctsWTrans, $_displayAllAccts,
                        $accrecno, $thisdb, $thiscr, $thisbal, 1, $firsttrans, $on_other, $other_level_bal, $thisFwd,
                        $element2Inf, $element3Inf
                    );

                    if ( $_offsetDetail == "true"
                         && in_array($tempTransArray['acct'][0]['recordno'], $this->_offsetaccounts) ) {
                        unset($tempTransArray['acct'][0]['trans']);
                        unset($tempTransArray['acct'][0]['element2']);
                        unset($tempTransArray['acct'][0]['element3']);
                        unset($tempTransArray['acct'][0]['other']);
                    }

                    /*-------------------------------------*/
                    /* Generate transaction array subtotal */
                    /*    items if the monthly or custom   */
                    /*    subtotal box was checked.        */
                    /* Note that the function called will  */
                    /*    determine if there are           */
                    /*    transactions to process.         */
                    /*-------------------------------------*/
                    if ( ( ( $this->params['monthlyOrCustomSubTotals'] ?? 'false' ) == 'true' )
                         && ( $this->params['type'] != kShowCSV )
                    ) {
                        if ( $this->params['EMAIL'] == 'true' ) {
                            if ( $this->params['EMAILREPORTTYPE'] != kShowCSV ) {
                                $tempTransArray =
                                    $this->ReformatTransArrayForPeriods(
                                        $tempTransArray,
                                        $tempTransArray,
                                        [],
                                        $mocstDatesArray
                                    );
                            }
                        } else {
                            $tempTransArray =
                                $this->ReformatTransArrayForPeriods(
                                    $tempTransArray,
                                    $tempTransArray,
                                    [],
                                    $mocstDatesArray
                                );
                        }
                    }

                    /*-------------------------------------*/
                    /* Invoke the function to process the  */
                    /*    doc column values.               */
                    /* Note that the function called will  */
                    /*    determine if there is processing */
                    /*    to be done.                      */
                    /*-------------------------------------*/
                    $tempTransArray =
                        $this->ProcessDocColumnValueProlog(
                            $tempTransArray
                        );

                    $this->_xmlStr .= $g->build_new("dummy", $tempTransArray, false);

                    // we are done with $tempTransArray
                    $tempTransArray = [];
                }

                $this->mcpEnabled = IsMCPSubscribed();

                if ( $this->mcpEnabled ) {
                    $reportHeader['report']['0']['multicurrency'] = 'true';
                    if ( IsMCMESubscribed() ) {
                        $this->CreateMCMEHeaderInfo($reportHeader);
                    }
                }

                // Enable Trx amount drill-down not just for MCME companies, enable it for multi entity companies as well
                // Set consolidationreport as true if
                // 1. consolidationreport parameter is not set above and
                // 2. it is multi entity company
                // 3. it is consolidation book
                $isConsolidationBook = &$reportHeader['report']['0']['consolidationreport'];
                if ( $isConsolidationBook != 'true' && IsMultiEntityCompany()
                     && GLBookManager::IsConsolidationBook(
                        $this->params['reportingBook'], false
                    )
                ) {
                    $isConsolidationBook = 'true';
                }

                $isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable = GLGroupReporter::getIsBookPostingToCSNEntryTable();
                // if the report is run for new data storage then remove debit & credit drill-down
                $reportHeader['report'][0]['isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable'] = ( $isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable ) ? 'T'
                    : 'F';

                // form the report header
                $reportHeader['report']['0']['ba_ppopblr'] = GetOperationId('ap/reports/billsregister');
                $reportHeader['report']['0']['grtotdb'] = $this->_gr_tot_db;
                $reportHeader['report']['0']['grtotcr'] = $this->_gr_tot_cr;
                $reportHeader['report']['0']['grtotbal'] = $this->_gr_tot_bal;
                if ( $this->params['type'] === kShowExcel || $this->params['offreporttype'] === kShowExcel ) {
                    $reportHeader['report']['0']['showHeader'] = 'true';
                    $this->getReportFilters();
                    if ( is_array($this->dimensionFilters) && ! empty($this->dimensionFilters) ) {
                        $dFTemp = $this->dimensionFilters;
                        unset($this->dimensionFilters);
                        $this->dimensionFilters['rtdim'] = $dFTemp;
                        unset($dFTemp);
                        $this->_xmlStr .= $g->build_new("dummy", $this->dimensionFilters, false);
                    }
                } else {
                    $reportHeader['report']['0']['showHeader'] = 'false';
                }
                if ( $this->params['type'] == '_offline' ) {
                    $reportHeader['report']['0']['report_format'] = $this->params['offreporttype'];
                } else {
                    $reportHeader['report']['0']['report_format'] = $this->params['type'];
                }

                //To Avail this Parameter in the XSL we need to assign it to the header
                if ( $this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET'] ) {
                    $reportHeader['report']['0']['reportingaccountset'] = $this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET'];
                    $reportHeader['report']['0']['rptAcctSet'] = $this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET'];
                    if ( $this->hasUnMapeedAccounts ) {
                        $reportHeader['report']['0']['rptAcctFooterText'] = kReportingAcctFooterText;
                    }
                }

                $reportHeader = $g->build_new("dummy", $reportHeader);

                $reportHeader = isl_substr($reportHeader, 0, ( isl_strlen($reportHeader) - 10 ));

                //  Keep encoding as UTF-8, because that's what the data is even in ISO-8859-1 env.
                $headerXML = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?><reportdata>" .
                             $reportHeader;
                //.$this->_xmlStr."</report></reportdata>";

                //sanitize the generated xml
                $this->_xmlStr = isl_str_clean(xmlSanitize($this->_xmlStr));

                // if the XML length is greater than 3Mb we use a temporary file to store it and ran XSLT on it
                // this is to avoid running out of memory  
                if ( strlen($this->_xmlStr) > 15 * 1024 * 1024 ) {
                    $fileName = (string) INTACCTtempnam('/tmp', 'GLR');
                    file_put_contents($fileName, $headerXML);
                    file_put_contents($fileName, $this->_xmlStr, FILE_APPEND);
                    file_put_contents($fileName, '</report></reportdata>', FILE_APPEND);
                    $dataxml = $fileName;
                } else {
                    $dataxml = $headerXML . $this->_xmlStr . '</report></reportdata>';
                }
                unset($this->_xmlStr);
                $this->_xmlStr = '';
                unset($headerXML);
            }
            $this->_gTranscationRecs = [];
            $this->_gSubTranscationRecs = [];

            return true;
        }
        global $gErr;
        $msg = "An error occured while processing your request.
        Required records could not be fetched.";
        $gErr->addError('GL-2832', __FILE__ . ':' . __LINE__, $msg);

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * This function builds a periods
     * array containing both trans and subtotals arrays for
     * insertion into the tempTransArray when the monthly or
     * custom subtotals option is selected for the general
     * ledger.   The function first loops thought the period
     * date array to process the periods to be included in
     * the general ledger report.   Within the date loop
     * the function loops through the transactions,
     * accumulating totals and adding the transactions to
     * the periods array.   Whenever transactions for a
     * period have been processed the function adds a
     * subtotal array to the periods array.   Finally the
     * function checks for the presence of a final subtotal
     * and if found adds it to the periods array.
     *
     * NOTE: This function assumes that the arrays passed to it
     * are properly formatted and does no format checking!
     * If the array is improperly formatted the results are
     * unspecified.
     *
     * NOTE: In the terminolgy used below node refers to a
     * single location in the array.   The lowest nodes are
     * at the root level.   Higher nodes are further from
     * the root.   A tier is a level of nodes such that all
     * are the same distance (level-wise) from the root.
     *
     * ---------------------------------------------------------
     * HISTORY: 28AUG2009 - function BuildPeriodsArray created.
     * ---------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * @param string[][] $arg1TransOnlyArray  Array containing only general ledger tran items
     * @param string[][] $arg2MocstDatesArray Array containing the monthly or custom subtotal tes
     * @param array      $arg3TempTransArray  Array containing the tempTransArray (used to obtain the id and name from
     *                                        the 'acct' node)
     *
     * @return array Periods array containing trans and subtotals
     */
    function BuildPeriodsArray(
        $arg1TransOnlyArray,
        $arg2MocstDatesArray,
        $arg3TempTransArray
    )
    {
        /*-------------------------------------*/
        /* Initialize local processing objects */
        /*-------------------------------------*/
        $resultArray = [];
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $tempDateArray = [];
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $tempTransItemArray = [];
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workCaption = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workCompDate = '';
        $workCount = 0;
        $workCR = '';
        $workDB = '';
        $workEndDate = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workEndResult = 0;
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workMonth = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workMonthNumber = 0;
        $workPeriodIndex = -1;
        $workPeriodIndexFlag = 'Y';
        $workStartDate = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workStartResult = 0;
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workArray = [];
        $workcompdateperiodarr = [];

        /*-----------------------------------------------*/
        /* Enter loop to process accounting period dates */
        /*-----------------------------------------------*/
        foreach ( $arg2MocstDatesArray as $tempDateArray ) {
            /*-----------------------------------------*/
            /* If transactions were processed create a */
            /*    monthly or custom subtotal array and */
            /*    add it to the result array.          */
            /* Note that the account caption is        */
            /*    formatted differently depending on   */
            /*    whether standard or custom           */
            /*    accounting periods are used.         */
            /* Note also that the invocation of date   */
            /*    using mktime is to generate a month  */
            /*    name ('April', 'May', etc.) for      */
            /*    report generation for non-custom     */
            /*    periods.                             */
            /* Note further that the                   */
            /*    workPeriodIndexFlag is set to Y so   */
            /*    that the next transaction processed  */
            /*    will cause the workPeriodIndex to be */
            /*    incremented.   This will ensure that */
            /*    consistant array indices are         */
            /*    generated.                           */
            /*-----------------------------------------*/
            if ( $workCount > 0 ) {
                $workPeriodIndexFlag = 'Y';

                if ( $this->params['nonStandardPeriods'] == '1' ) {
                    $workCaption = 'Period ';
                    $workCaption .= $workStartDate;
                    $workCaption .= ' to ';
                    $workCaption .= $workEndDate;
                } else {
                    $workMonthNumber =
                        GetMonthFromDate($workStartDate);
                    $workMonth =
                        date(
                            'F',
                            mktime(
                                0,
                                0,
                                0,
                                $workMonthNumber,
                                1,
                                2000
                            )
                        );
                    $workCaption = $workMonth;
                }

                $workCaption .= ' Totals for ';
                $workCaption .= $arg3TempTransArray['acct'][0]['id'];
                $workCaption .= ' ';
                $workCaption .= $arg3TempTransArray['acct'][0]['name'];

                $workArray = [];
                $workArray['caption'] = $workCaption;
                $workArray['cr'] = $workCR;
                $workArray['db'] = $workDB;

                $resultArray['periods']
                [$workPeriodIndex]
                ['subtotal-for-period']
                []
                    = $workArray;

                unset($workArray);
            }   /*  End of if workCount > 0  */

            /*-------------------------------*/
            /* Reinitialize variables before */
            /*    entering transaction loop  */
            /*-------------------------------*/
            $workCount = 0;
            $workCR = '';
            $workDB = '';
            $workEndDate = $tempDateArray['END_DATE'];
            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
            $workEndResult = 0;
            $workStartDate = $tempDateArray['START_DATE'];
            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
            $workStartResult = 0;

            /*-------------------------------------------*/
            /* Enter loop to process transactions and    */
            /*    acquire the posted date ('date' in the */
            /*    temporarys tran array) for comparison  */
            /*-------------------------------------------*/
            foreach ( $arg1TransOnlyArray
                      as $tempTransItemArray ) {
                $workCompDate = $tempTransItemArray['date'];
                if ( ! $workcompdateperiodarr[$workCompDate] ) {
                    $workCompDatePeriod = Date2Period($workCompDate);
                    $workcompdateperiodarr[$workCompDate] = $workCompDatePeriod;
                } else {
                    $workCompDatePeriod = $workcompdateperiodarr[$workCompDate];
                }

                /*----------------------------------------*/
                /* Determine if posted date falls within  */
                /*    the accounting date range (note -   */
                /*    the DateCompare function checks     */
                /*    for greater than or less than only) */
                /*----------------------------------------*/
                if ( $workCompDatePeriod >= $tempDateArray['SDD2P']
                     && $workCompDatePeriod <= $tempDateArray['EDD2P'] ) {
                    /*-----------------------------------*/
                    /* Posted date falls in range so     */
                    /*    increment the workPeriodIndex  */
                    /*    if it has not already been     */
                    /*    incremented for this set of    */
                    /*    transactions (this assures     */
                    /*    that the array will have       */
                    /*    consistant indices if one of   */
                    /*    the accounting periods has no  */
                    /*    transactions), accumulate      */
                    /*    summary information, increment */
                    /*    count, and add the transaction */
                    /*    item to the result array       */
                    /*-----------------------------------*/
                    if ( $workPeriodIndexFlag == 'Y' ) {
                        $workPeriodIndex = $workPeriodIndex + 1;
                        $workPeriodIndexFlag = 'N';
                    }

                    $workDB = ibcadd($workDB, $tempTransItemArray['db']);
                    $workCR = ibcadd($workCR, $tempTransItemArray['cr']);
                    $workCount = $workCount + 1;

                    $resultArray['periods']
                    [$workPeriodIndex]
                    ['trans']
                    []
                        = $tempTransItemArray;
                }   /* End of if date match */
            }   /* End of transaction loop */
        }   /* End of date loop */

        /*-------------------------------------------------*/
        /* If there is a final monthly or custom subtotal  */
        /*    array then add it to the transaction array   */
        /*    (see above for use of date/mktime functions) */
        /*-------------------------------------------------*/
        if ( $workCount > 0 ) {
            if ( $this->params['nonStandardPeriods'] == '1' ) {
                $workCaption = 'Period ';
                $workCaption .= $workStartDate;
                $workCaption .= ' to ';
                $workCaption .= $workEndDate;
            } else {
                $workMonthNumber = GetMonthFromDate($workStartDate);
                $workMonth =
                    date(
                        'F',
                        mktime(
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            $workMonthNumber,
                            1,
                            2000
                        )
                    );
                $workCaption = $workMonth;
            }

            $workCaption .= ' Totals for ';
            $workCaption .= $arg3TempTransArray['acct'][0]['id'];
            $workCaption .= ' ';
            $workCaption .= $arg3TempTransArray['acct'][0]['name'];

            $workArray = [];
            $workArray['caption'] = $workCaption;
            $workArray['cr'] = $workCR;
            $workArray['db'] = $workDB;

            $resultArray['periods']
            [$workPeriodIndex]
            ['subtotal-for-period']
            []
                = $workArray;

            unset($workArray);
        }   /*  End of if final work count > 0  */

        /*--------------------------------------*/
        /* Return to invocation point returning */
        /*    the result array                  */

        /*--------------------------------------*/

        return $resultArray;
    }

    /**
     * This function recursively
     * transverses a complex array and rebuilds the array to
     * include monthly or custom subtotals.   The array is
     * of the form of the General Ledger tempTransArray that
     * is used to generate XML code.   The function will
     * first split off any ['acct'][0] that may be found at
     * the zeroth level of the array.   Next the function
     * will travel across tiers of the array looking for
     * 'element2', 'element3', 'other', 'sub', or 'trans'
     * nodes.   If one of these nodes other than 'trans'
     * if found the function is reentered recursively to
     * process the nodes on the next highest tier.   If a
     * 'trans' node is found then the BuildPeriodsArray
     * function is invoked to return a periods array.   The
     * periods array is inserted into the proper place in
     * the original tempTransArray by unsetting the 'trans'
     * node and replacing it will the periods array.
     * NOTE: This function assumes that the arrays passed to it
     * are properly formatted and does no format checking!
     * If the array is improperly formatted the results are
     * unspecified.
     * NOTE: In the terminolgy used below node refers to a
     * single location in the array.   The lowest nodes are
     * at the root level.   Higher nodes are further from
     * the root.   A tier is a level of nodes such that all
     * are the same distance (level-wise) from the root.
     * ---------------------------------------------------------
     * HISTORY: 27AUG2009 - function
     * ReformatTransArrayForPeriods
     * created.
     * ---------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * @param array $arg1TransArray       Array in General Ledger tempTransArray format.
     *                                    During the first (non-recursive) call to this
     *                                    function ARG1 will contain the tempTransArray
     *                                    and will be equal to ARG2.   During subsequent
     *                                    (recursive) calls to this function ARG1 will
     *                                    contain the modified array that will be
     *                                    returned from this function when all recursive
     *                                    calls are complete.
     * @param array $arg2WorkArray        Work array that is a fragment of the original
     *                                    tempTransArray.   This is the array from which
     *                                    information is extracted during the various
     *                                    recursive calls.   During the first (non-
     *                                    recursive) call to this function ARG1 and ARG2
     *                                    will be equal.
     * @param array $arg3ReformatLocArray Work array to contain the reformat location
     *                                    information.   This array contains the data
     *                                    needed to correctly modify the tempTransArray.
     * @param array $arg4MocstDatesArray  Monthly or custom subtotals (mocst) dates
     *                                    array.
     *
     * @return  array The tempTransArray modified to include monthly or custom subtotals
     */
    function ReformatTransArrayForPeriods(
        $arg1TransArray,
        $arg2WorkArray,
        $arg3ReformatLocArray,
        $arg4MocstDatesArray
    )
    {
        /*-------------------------------------*/
        /* Initialize local processing objects */
        /*-------------------------------------*/
        /* Note that workReturnArray is        */
        /*    initialized to arg1TransArray.   */
        /*    This is done so that the         */
        /*    unchanged arg1TransArray can be  */
        /*    returned if no period arrays are */
        /*    added during the processing.     */
        /*-------------------------------------*/
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workNodeKey = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workNodeArray = [];
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workRecurseKey = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workRecurseArray = [];
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workReformattedTransArray = [];
        $workReturnArray = $arg1TransArray;
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $workTransArray = [];
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $uCmdStrFrag = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $uCmdStrReset = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $uCmdStrUnset = '';

        /*-------------------------------------------*/
        /* Determine if the zeroth key in the array  */
        /*    is 'acct'.   If so then split off the  */
        /*    'acct' node and continue processing.   */
        /* NOTE: The PHP current function is used to */
        /*    reset the internal array pointer so    */
        /*    that the PHP key function will return  */
        /*    the zeroth key.   The return from the  */
        /*    key function is cast to a string for   */
        /*    the comparison since 'acct' is a       */
        /*    string literal.                        */
        /*-------------------------------------------*/
        current($arg2WorkArray);

        $workNodeKey = (string) key($arg2WorkArray);

        if ( $workNodeKey === 'acct' ) {
            $workTransArray = $arg2WorkArray['acct'][0];
            $arg3ReformatLocArray = [ 'acct', 0 ];
        } else {
            $workTransArray = $arg2WorkArray;
        }

        /*------------------------------------------*/
        /* If there are nodes to process then enter */
        /*    a foreach loop to process all the     */
        /*    nodes on the current tier             */
        /*------------------------------------------*/
        if ( count($workTransArray) > 0 ) {
            foreach ( $workTransArray as
                      $workNodeKey => $workNodeArray ) {
                /*---------------------------*/
                /* Bypass non-relevant nodes */
                /*---------------------------*/
                if ( ( $workNodeKey != 'element2' )
                     && ( $workNodeKey != 'element3' )
                     && ( $workNodeKey != 'other' )
                     && ( $workNodeKey != 'sub' )
                     && ( $workNodeKey != 'trans' )
                ) {
                    continue;
                }

                /*---------------------------------------------*/
                /* Reformat a trans node if there is more than */
                /*    a single transaction for the node        */
                /*---------------------------------------------*/
                if ( $workNodeKey == 'trans' ) {
                    /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                    $workReformattedTransArray =
                        $this->BuildPeriodsArray(
                            $workNodeArray,
                            $arg4MocstDatesArray,
                            $arg1TransArray
                        );

                    /*---------------------------------------*/
                    /* Build the command strings to unset an */
                    /*    array trans node and reset it with */
                    /*    the periods node                   */
                    /*---------------------------------------*/
                    $uCmdStrFrag = '$workReturnArray';

                    foreach ( $arg3ReformatLocArray as $workLoc ) {
                        $uCmdStrFrag .= "['$workLoc']";
                    }

                    $uCmdStrReset = $uCmdStrFrag;
                    $uCmdStrReset .= "['periods']";
                    $uCmdStrReset .= ' = $workReformattedTransArray';
                    $uCmdStrReset .= "['periods'];";

                    $uCmdStrUnset = 'unset(' . $uCmdStrFrag . "['trans']);";

                    /*--------------------------------------*/
                    /* Use the PHP eval function to execute */
                    /*    the command strings and modify    */
                    /*    the workReturnArray which will be */
                    /*    returned to the invoking function */
                    /*--------------------------------------*/
                    eval($uCmdStrUnset);
                    eval($uCmdStrReset);
                }   /*  End of if work node key = 'trans'  */

                /*----------------------------------------*/
                /* This is a relevant non-trans node so   */
                /*    recursively invoke this function to */
                /*    process any nodes that lie above    */
                /*    the current node in the array       */
                /*----------------------------------------*/
                else {
                    foreach ( $workNodeArray as
                              $workRecurseKey => $workRecurseArray ) {
                        array_push(
                            $arg3ReformatLocArray,
                            $workNodeKey
                        );
                        array_push(
                            $arg3ReformatLocArray,
                            $workRecurseKey
                        );

                        $workReturnArray =
                            $this->ReformatTransArrayForPeriods(
                                $workReturnArray,
                                $workRecurseArray,
                                $arg3ReformatLocArray,
                                $arg4MocstDatesArray
                            );

                        array_pop($arg3ReformatLocArray);
                        array_pop($arg3ReformatLocArray);
                    }   /* End of tier foreach loop  */
                }   /*  End of else relevant non-trans node  */
            }   /*  End of workTransArray foreach loop  */
        }   /*  End of if there are nodes to process  */

        /*-----------------------------------------*/
        /* At this point there are no more nodes   */
        /*    to process either because the node   */
        /*    id not set which means that the node */
        /*    being processed when a recursive     */
        /*    call was made is a topmost node      */
        /*    or the foreach loop has ended which  */
        /*    means that the current tier has      */
        /*    has been processed.                  */
        /* In either case return to invocation     */
        /*    point returning the modified array   */

        /*-----------------------------------------*/

        return $workReturnArray;
    }

    /**
     * This function is the prolog
     * function for the doc column value processing.   It
     * checks the reporting book, show detail, and doc
     * column select values from the user interface to
     * determine if doc column value processing is needed.
     * If so it invokes the ProcessDocColumnValueRecurse
     * function to perform the doc column value processing.
     *
     * NOTE: This function is separated from the
     * ProcessDocColumnValueRecurse function so the user
     * interface values will not have to be passed through
     * levels of recursion.   It also encapsulates the
     * intelligence that determines whether doc column value
     * processing is required in a single function.
     *
     * @param array $arg1TempTransArray The General Ledger tempTransArray.
     *
     * @return array The tempTransArray modified to include the selected doc column value.
     */
    function ProcessDocColumnValueProlog(
        $arg1TempTransArray
    )
    {
        /*-------------------------------------------------*/
        /* Retrieve multibook status and accounting method */
        /*-------------------------------------------------*/
        $sIsMultibooks = IsOperatingMultipleBooks();
        $sAccountingMethod = GetAccountingMethod();

        /*---------------------------------------------------*/
        /* If the reporting book is 'ACCRUAL' or the company */
        /*    is non-multibook and the accounting method is  */
        /*    accrual then continue processing               */
        /*---------------------------------------------------*/
        if ( ( $this->params['reportingBook'] == 'ACCRUAL' )
             || ( ( $sIsMultibooks == '' )
                  && ( $sAccountingMethod == 'A' ) )
        ) {
            /*-------------------------------------*/
            /* If the show detail value is not 'D' */
            /*    (for Detail) then return the     */
            /*    original array as no doc         */
            /*    column value processing          */
            /*    needs to be done                 */
            /*-------------------------------------*/
            if ( $this->params['showdetail'] != 'D' ) {
                return ( $arg1TempTransArray );
            }

            /*---------------------------------------*/
            /* If the doc column select value is not */
            /*    'B' (Bill/Invoice/Adjustment       */
            /*    Number) then return the original   */
            /*    array as it is correct             */
            /*---------------------------------------*/
            if ( $this->params['docColumnValue'] != 'B' ) {
                return ( $arg1TempTransArray );
            }

            /*----------------------------------*/
            /* Declare local processing objects */
            /*----------------------------------*/
            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
            $workReturnArray = [];

            /*--------------------------------------------*/
            /* At this point the reportingBook is accrual */
            /*    the showdetail is D (for Detail) and    */
            /*    the doc column select value is B (for   */
            /*    Billing/Invoice/Adjustment Number) so   */
            /*    invoke the function to modify the doc   */
            /*    column values as required               */
            /*--------------------------------------------*/

            $this->ProcessDocColumnValueRecurse($arg1TempTransArray);
            $workReturnArray = $arg1TempTransArray;
        } else {
            /*---------------------------------------------*/
            /* If this point is reached then no doc column */
            /*    processing needs to be done so return    */
            /*    the original array                       */
            /*---------------------------------------------*/
            return ( $arg1TempTransArray );
        }

        /*--------------------------------------*/
        /* Return to invocation point returning */
        /*    the modified array                */

        /*--------------------------------------*/

        return $workReturnArray;
    }

    /**
     * @param array &$tempTransArray
     */
    function ProcessDocColumnValueRecurse(&$tempTransArray)
    {
        foreach ( $tempTransArray as $keyName => &$transArray ) {
            if ( $keyName == 'trans' ) {
                if ( is_array($transArray) ) {
                    foreach ( $transArray as &$tempItemArray ) {
                        $sDoc = $tempItemArray['doc'];
                        $sRecordId = $tempItemArray['recordid'];
                        $sTranType = $tempItemArray['trtype'];

                        if ( ( ( $sTranType == 'pi' )
                               || ( $sTranType == 'ri' )
                               || ( $sTranType == 'pa' )
                               || ( $sTranType == 'ra' ) )
                             && ( $sDoc != '' )
                             && ( $sRecordId != '' )
                        ) {
                            $tempItemArray['doc'] = $sRecordId;
                        }

                        foreach ( $tempItemArray['sub'] as &$subs ) {
                            $subDoc = $subs['doc'];
                            $subRecordId = $subs['recordid'];
                            $subTranType = $subs['trtype'];

                            if ( ( ( $subTranType == 'pi' )
                                   || ( $subTranType == 'ri' )
                                   || ( $subTranType == 'pa' )
                                   || ( $subTranType == 'ra' ) )
                                 && ( $subDoc != '' )
                                 && ( $subRecordId != '' )
                            ) {
                                $subs['doc'] = $subRecordId;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if ( ( $keyName == 'acct' )
                        || ( $keyName == 'element2' )
                        || ( $keyName == 'element3' )
                        || ( $keyName == 'other' )
                        || ( $keyName == 'sub' )
                        || ( $keyName == 'periods' )
            ) {
                if ( is_array($transArray) ) {
                    foreach ( $transArray as &$tempInner ) {
                        $this->ProcessDocColumnValueRecurse($tempInner);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array  $inArr     the array containing the parent - child information
     * @param int    $inElement the value of the recNo for which the child id's have to be found
     * @param string $path      the id to start with, this is used as a placeholder for the recursive functionality
     *
     * @return string    Returns the rec# of all the descendents as a string
     *                       Eg. if Dept1 is the parent of Dept2
     *                       if Dept1's recNo is passed then the function will retun
     *                          Dept11Rec# : Dept2Rec#
     *                       if Dept2's recNo is passed then the function will retun
     *                           Dept2Rec#
     *                       NOTES:
     *                           the inArr structure is as follows
     *                           [
     *                           recNo1 => [
     *                              "PARENT" => 'parentRecNo', <-- must be blank if no parent
     *                              "ELEMENTID" => 'someId',
     *                              "RECORDNO" => 'somerec#',
     *                              .... other details
     *                           ],
     *                           recNo2 => [
     *                              "PARENT" => 'parentRecNo',
     *                              "ELEMENTID" => 'someId',
     *                              "RECORDNO" => 'somerec#',
     *                              .... other details
     *                           ],
     *                           .... other entries
     *                           ]
     */
    function getChildrenPath($inArr, $inElement, $path)
    {
        // check if any other array element has its parent set as the passed inelement
        $tempArray = [];
        foreach ( $inArr as $val ) {
            if ( $val['PARENT'] == $inElement ) {
                // somebodys's parent is matching the passed inElement
                // we found a child of the passed inElement , retain it
                $tempArray[] = $this->getChildrenPath($inArr, $val['RECORDNO'], $val['RECORDNO']);
            }
        }
        if ( count($tempArray) == 0 ) {
            // no children found 
            // just return the passed path
            return $path;
        } else {
            // some children are found 
            // concat all teh children and return it
            $path = $path . ":" . implode(":", $tempArray);

            return $path;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param string $_inType  decision varaible, based on this the loc or dept table is queried
     * @param string $pathName based on this the path info is set. the path will either be element2 / element3
     *                         depending on the caller (or any other value)
     *
     * @return array  Array will return the department / location details
     *
     *                NOTES:
     *                in all the queries, a column called uniqueId if fetched, which is the rec# concatenated with the
     *                level ... delimited by "_" this will be usefule in a case where the GLReport is needed like the
     *                Individual report. uses are, in case of Location / Department groups where the Parent as well as
     *                the child are part of the Group. currently, we are ignoring the children. But in case individaul
     *                reports are necessary, we should activate the Uniqued concept and match the transaction records
     *                with the rec# as part of the the uniqueid , rathar than the recordno.
     */
    function getElementHierarchy($_inType, $pathName)
    {
        $_loc = $this->params['loc'] ?? [];
        $_dept = $this->params['dept'] ?? [];
        $_filterTransactions = $this->params['filterTransactions'];

        $stmt[0] = "";
        $stmt[1] = GetMyCompany();

        // Sort the locations according to the sortorder within the location group selected.
        $locgrpsortordsel = '';
        $locgrpsortordsort = '';
        if ( is_array($_loc) && count($_loc) > 1 ) {
            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
            $locgrpselsortclause = [];
            $locgrpselsortclause = $this->LocGrpSelSortClause($this->params, $locgrprec, $_filterTransactions);
            if ( $locgrprec ) {
                $locgrpsortordsel = $locgrpselsortclause['sel'];
                $locgrpsortordsort = $locgrpselsortclause['ordby'];
            }
        }
        $deptgrpsortordsel = '';
        $deptgrpsortordsort = '';
        if ( is_array($_dept) && count($_dept) > 1 ) {
            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
            $deptgrpselsortclause = [];
            $deptgrpselsortclause = $this->DeptGrpSelSortClause($this->params, $deptgrprec);
            if ( $deptgrprec ) {
                $deptgrpsortordsel = $deptgrpselsortclause['sel'];
                $deptgrpsortordsort = $deptgrpselsortclause['ordby'];
            }
        }

        $megaFilter = '';
        if ( IsMultiEntityCompany() ) {
            $megaFilter =
                " and exists ( select 1 from sessionloc sl where sl.cny# = :1 and sl.locationkey = record# ) ";
        }

        if ( $_inType == "dept" ) {
            // restrict the department fect based on the department filter that the user selected
            if ( isNonEmptyArray($_dept) ) {
                $deptRecs = [];
                foreach ( $_dept as $deptIdName ) {
                    [ $_deptid ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($deptIdName));
                    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                    GetRecordNo($_userid, 'department', $_deptid, $_deptRec);
                    $deptRecs[] = $_deptRec;
                }

                if ( count($deptRecs) == 0 || $deptRecs == '' ) {
                    $query =
                        "select record# RECORDNO, level as lvl, title NAME, 
						case when level=1 then null else parent# end as PARENT, dept_no ELEMENTID, 
						to_char(record#) || '_' || level as uniqueid
					from department 
					start with parent# is null and cny#=:1 
					connect by prior record# = parent# and cny#=:1 ";
                } else {
                    $query =
                        "WITH dept_mat as ( 
						select record# as rec#, max (level) as lvl 
						from departmentmst 
						start with cny# = :1 and " . PrepINClauseStmt('', $deptRecs, 'record#', false, 'departmentmst') . "
						connect by prior record# = parent# and cny# = :1 
						group by record#
					) 
					SELECT 
					   record# RECORDNO, level as lvl, title NAME, 
					   case when level=1 then null else parent# end as PARENT, 
					   dept_no ELEMENTID, to_char(record#) || '_' || level as uniqueid 
                       $deptgrpsortordsel
					FROM department, dept_mat a
					WHERE a.rec# = record# and a.lvl = level
					START WITH cny# = :1 and " . PrepINClauseStmt('', $deptRecs, 'record#', false, 'departmentmst') . "
					CONNECT BY PRIOR record# = parent# and cny# = :1 
                    $deptgrpsortordsort";
                }
            } else {
                // user has not selected any department
                // fetch only the ones that have transactions
                $query =
                    "select record# RECORDNO, level as lvl, title NAME, 
					case when level=1 then null else parent# end as PARENT, 
					dept_no ELEMENTID, to_char(record#) || '_' || level as uniqueid
				from department 
				start with parent# is null and cny#=:1 
				connect by prior record# = parent# and cny#=:1 ";
            }
            if ( isset($deptgrprec) && ! Util::php7eqEmptyStr($deptgrprec) ) {
                $stmt[2] = $deptgrprec;
            }
        } else if ( $_inType == "loc" ) {
            // form the location clause
            if ( isNonEmptyArray($_loc) ) {
                $locRecs = [];
                foreach ( $_loc as $locIdName ) {
                    [ $_locid ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($locIdName));
                    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                    GetRecordNo($_userid, 'location', $_locid, $_locRec);
                    $locRecs[] = $_locRec;
                }
                if ( count($locRecs) == 0 || $locRecs == '' ) {
                    $query = ' select record# RECORDNO, level lvl, name NAME, parentkey PARENT, LOCATION_NO ELEMENTID, to_char(record#) || \'_\' || level as uniqueid 
				           from locationmst 
						   start with parentkey is null and cny#=:1 
						   connect by prior record# = parentkey and cny#=:1 ';
                } else {
                    if ( $_filterTransactions == 'CHILDREN' ) {
                        // if the location group contains children/descendents we need to elminate the same
                        $query =
                            "WITH loc_mat as ( 
							select record# as rec#, max (level) as lvl 
							from locationmst
							start with cny# = :1 and " . PrepINClauseStmt('', $locRecs, 'parentkey', false, 'locationmst') . "
							connect by prior record# = parentkey and cny# = :1 
							group by record#
						) 
						SELECT 
							record# RECORDNO, name NAME, 
							case when level=1 then null else parentkey end as PARENT, 
							LOCATION_NO ELEMENTID, to_char(record#) || '_' || level as uniqueid,
							level as lvl
                            $locgrpsortordsel
						FROM 
							locationmst, loc_mat a
						WHERE a.rec# = record# and a.lvl = level $megaFilter
						start with cny# = :1 and " . PrepINClauseStmt('', $locRecs, 'parentkey', false, 'locationmst') . "
						CONNECT BY PRIOR record# = parentkey and cny# = :1 
                        $locgrpsortordsort";
                    } else if ( $_filterTransactions == 'SELF' ) {
                        $query =
                            "select record# RECORDNO, 1 as lvl, name NAME, null as PARENT, 
							LOCATION_NO ELEMENTID , to_char(record#) || '_1' as uniqueid
                            $locgrpsortordsel
				        from location 
						where " . PrepINClauseStmt('', $locRecs, 'record#', false, 'location') . " and cny#=:1 
                        $locgrpsortordsort";
                    } else { // All locations
                        $query =
                            "WITH loc_mat as ( 
						select record# as rec#, max (level) as lvl 
						from locationmst
						start with cny# = :1 and " . PrepINClauseStmt('', $locRecs, 'record#', false, 'locationmst') . "
						connect by prior record# = parentkey and cny# = :1 
						group by record#
					)
					SELECT 
						record# RECORDNO, name NAME, 
						case when level=1 then null else parentkey end as PARENT, 
						LOCATION_NO ELEMENTID, to_char(record#) || '_' || level as uniqueid, 
                        level as lvl $locgrpsortordsel
					FROM 
						locationmst, loc_mat a 
					WHERE a. rec# = record# and a.lvl = level $megaFilter
					START WITH cny# = :1  and " . PrepINClauseStmt('', $locRecs, 'record#', false, 'locationmst') . "
					CONNECT BY PRIOR record# = parentkey and cny# = :1 
                    $locgrpsortordsort";
                    }
                }
                if ( isset($locgrprec) && $locgrprec != '' ) {
                    $stmt[2] = $locgrprec;
                }
            } else {
                $query = ' select record# RECORDNO, level as lvl, name NAME, parentkey PARENT, 
			            LOCATION_NO ELEMENTID , to_char(record#) || \'_\' || level as uniqueid
				        from locationmst
						start with parentkey is null and cny#=:1 
						connect by prior record# = parentkey and cny#=:1 ';
            }
        }

        /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
        $stmt[0] = $query;
        $elementRecs = QueryResult($stmt);

        if ( empty($elementRecs) ) {
            // there are no elements present
            // return an empty array to the caller
            return [];
        }

        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $retarray = [];
        $parentCtr = 0;
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $levelCtr = 0;
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $childLevelCtr = 0;
        foreach ( $elementRecs as $elementRecords ) {
            $retArray[$elementRecords['RECORDNO']] = $elementRecords;
            [ , $tempLevel ] = explode("_", $elementRecords['UNIQUEID']);
            if ( $tempLevel == 1 ) {
                eval("\$" . ( 'ELEMENT' . $elementRecords['RECORDNO'] ) . " = 0;");
                $retArray[$elementRecords['RECORDNO']]['PATH'] = '["' . $pathName . '"]["' . $parentCtr . '"]';
                $parentCtr++;
            } else {
                $parentstring = "ELEMENT" . $elementRecords['PARENT'];
                $retArray[$elementRecords['RECORDNO']]["PATH"] =
                    $retArray[$elementRecords['PARENT']]["PATH"] . '["' . $pathName . '"]' . '["' . $$parentstring
                    . '"]';
                eval("\$" . ( 'ELEMENT' . $elementRecords['PARENT'] ) . "++;");
                eval("\$" . ( 'ELEMENT' . $elementRecords['RECORDNO'] ) . " = 0;");
            }
        }
        // now loop thru the new array and concat the parent names
        /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
        foreach ( $retArray as $recNo => $recDetails ) {
            $retArray[$recNo]['FULLNAME'] = $this->getFullName($retArray, $recDetails['RECORDNO'], $recDetails['NAME']);
            // this is needed for getting the balance forward for the lower hierachy!!
            // since our balance fwd array contains individuals balances of depatment (acct-locid-deptid), 
            // we need this info to navigate using the id's and get the totals
            $retArray[$recNo]['IDPATH'] =
                $this->getFullPath($retArray, $recDetails['RECORDNO'], $recDetails['RECORDNO']);
            // we need this info to navigate using the id's and get the totals
            $retArray[$recNo]['CHILDPATH'] =
                $this->getChildrenPath($retArray, $recDetails['RECORDNO'], $recDetails['RECORDNO']);
        }

        return $retArray;
    }

    /**
     * @param array|string $inArr the array which contains the totals information
     * @param float|int    $total a place holder for recursive functionality
     *
     * @return float|int|string Total l
     *                          NOTES:
     *                              the inArr structure is as follows
     *                              [
     *                                  id = amount1
     *                              ]    an array with only one entry (in case of account only)
     *                              (or)
     *                              [
     *                                  id = [id = amount11],[id = amount12], ...
     *                              ]    an array with an array of entries (in case of Account-department ,
     *                              Account-location)
     *                              [
     *                                  id = [id = amount11],[id = amount12], ...
     *                              ]
     *                                   an array with an array of array
     *                                   of entries  (in case of ALD /
     *                                   ADL) the functiion recursively
     *                                   calls itself and totals up the
     *                                   values and returns it as a
     *                                   string if any problems with the
     *                                   balance forward amount dislpay,
     *                                   this function has to be checked
     */
    function getTotalBalFwd($inArr, $total = 0)
    {
        // inArr may be a single dimension array , 2 dimension array or 3 dimension array ... or n dimension
        // assumption is that the value is always an array or a numerical value
        // ie only acct totals, acct - dep/loc totals or acct - dept/loc - loc/dept totals available
        // if single dimension array then retin the assoiciated value
        // if 2 dim array then return the total of the individual elements
        // if 3 dim array then loop thru 2 times and return the total
        $retTotal = $total;
        if ( is_array($inArr) ) {
            // to continue only if array is passed
            foreach ( $inArr as $ValArr ) {
                if ( is_array($ValArr) ) {
                    $retTotal = $this->getTotalBalFwd($ValArr, $retTotal);
                } else {
                    $retTotal = ibcadd($retTotal, $ValArr, 14, 1);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // inarr is not an array 
            // accept the value
            $retTotal = ibcadd($inArr, '0', 14, 1);
        }

        return $retTotal;
    }

    /**
     * @param array  $inArr        the complete array of balance fwd
     * @param int    $startwith    an identifier to startwith , the acct info in our case
     * @param string $hierarchyMap a string which will containg the hierarchy map, a string with : (colon) separated
     *                             rec# for which the hierarchy totals have to be retrieved
     *
     * @return float|int|string Total value
     *                          NOTES:
     *                          the inArr structure is as follows
     *                          [
     *                              id = amount1
     *                          ]    an array with only one entry (in case of account only)
     *                          (or)
     *                          [
     *                              id = [id = amount11],[id = amount12], ...
     *                          ]    an array with an array of entries (in case of Account-department ,
     *                          Account-location)
     *                          [
     *                              id = [id = amount11],[id = amount12], ...
     *                          ]   an array with an array of array of entries  (in case of ALD / ADL)
     *                          the functiion recursively calls itself and totals up the values and returns it as a
     *                          string if any problems with the balance forward amount dislpay, this function has to be
     *                          checked
     */
    function getTotalBalFwdNew($inArr, /** @noinspection PhpUnusedParameterInspection */ $startwith = 0,
                               $hierarchyMap = '')
    {
        if ($hierarchyMap == '' || !isset($hierarchyMap)) {
            return $this->getTotalBalFwd($inArr);
        }

        if (!is_array($inArr)) {
            return '0';
        }

        $childArray = explode(":", $hierarchyMap);
        $totals = '0';

        foreach ($childArray as $child) {
            if (isset($inArr[$child])) {
                $totals = ibcadd($totals, $this->getTotalBalFwd($inArr[$child]), 14, 1);
            }
        }

        return $totals;
    }

    /**
     * @param array     &   $curline
     * @param string        $_zeroAcctsWTrans
     * @param string        $_displayAllAccts
     * @param int           $row
     * @param float|int    &$thisdb
     * @param float|int    &$thiscr

     * @param int           $level
     * @param bool         &$firsttrans
