     * @param string|float  $other_level_bal
     * @param string        $thisfwd
     * @param string        $element2Inf
     * @param string        $element3Inf
     */
    function BuildReportTotals(&$curline, $_zeroAcctsWTrans, $_displayAllAccts, $row,
                               &$thisdb, &$thiscr, &$thisbal, $level, &$firsttrans, $on_other, $other_level_bal,
                               $thisfwd = '0', $element2Inf = '', $element3Inf = ''
    )
    {
        // to keep PHP happy, these can by NULL but not non-existant....
        $checkThese = [ 'other', 'trans', 'group', 'acct', 'sub', 'element2', 'element3' ];
        foreach ( $checkThese as $field ) {
            if ( ! isset($curline[$field]) ) {
                $curline[$field] = null;    // so it exists, but is null
            }
        }

        if ( ! $curline['other'] && ! $curline['trans'] && ! $curline['group'] && ! $curline['acct']
             && ! $curline['sub']
             && ! $curline['element2']
             && ! $curline['element3'] ) {
            $thisdb = 0;
            $thiscr = 0;
            $thisbal = 0;

            return;
        }

        $gBalanceAsOfDate = $this->_gBalanceAsOfDate;
        /*    global $gr_tot_db;
        global $gr_tot_cr;
        global $gr_tot_bal;
        */
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $_deptlocflag = $this->params['deptlocflag'] ?? null;
        $_showDeptLocActivity = $this->params['showDeptLocActivity'] ?? null;

        $thisleveldb = '';
        $thislevelcr = '';
        $thislevelbal = '';
        if ( $curline['acct'] ) {
            $level++;
            for ( $i = count($curline['acct']) - 1; $i >= 0; $i-- ) {
                $firsttrans = true;
                $thisdb = 0;
                $thiscr = 0;
                $thisbal = 0;
                $thisfwd = $curline['acct']["$i"]['fwd'] ?? '0';
                $this->BuildReportTotals(
                    $curline['acct']["$i"], $_zeroAcctsWTrans, $_displayAllAccts,
                    ( $curline['acct']["$i"]['recordno'] ? : $row ),
                    $thisdb, $thiscr, $thisbal, $level, $firsttrans, false, $other_level_bal, $thisfwd
                );
                $accbalfwd = ibcadd($curline['acct']["$i"]['fwd'] ?? '0', $other_level_bal, 14, 1);
                $curline['acct']["$i"]['db'] = $thisdb ? : 0;
                $curline['acct']["$i"]['cr'] = $thiscr ? : 0;
                $curline['acct']["$i"]['nc'] = ibcsub($thisdb, $thiscr, 14, 1);
                $curline['acct']["$i"]['bal'] = ( $thisbal || $accbalfwd ) ? ibcadd($thisbal, $accbalfwd, 14, 1) : 0;
                $curline['acct']["$i"]['level'] = $level;
                $thisleveldb =
                    $thisdb ? ibcadd($thisleveldb, $thisdb, 14, 1) : ibcadd($thisleveldb, $other_level_bal, 14, 1);
                $thislevelcr =
                    $thiscr ? ibcadd($thislevelcr, $thiscr, 14, 1) : ibcadd($thislevelcr, $other_level_bal, 14, 1);
                $thislevelbal =
                    ( $thisbal || $accbalfwd ) ? ibcadd($thislevelbal, ibcadd($thisbal, $accbalfwd, 14, 1), 14, 1)
                        : ibcadd($thislevelbal, $other_level_bal, 14, 1);

                $shouldinclude =
                    ( ( $accbalfwd != 0 && $accbalfwd != '' ) || ( $thisbal != 0 && $thisbal != '' ) ) ? true : '';
                $_nullTrans = ( ( $thisdb == 0 || $thisdb == '' ) && ( $thiscr == 0 || $thiscr == '' ) ) ? 'Y' : 'N';
                $printRow = true;

                if ( printCriteria(
                         $shouldinclude, $accbalfwd, $_nullTrans, $_zeroAcctsWTrans, $_displayAllAccts) == false ) {
                    if ( count($curline['acct']) == 1 ) {
                        $curline = array_delete($curline, 'acct');
                        $printRow = false;
                    } else if ( count($curline['acct']) > 1 ) {
                        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                        $temp = array_splice($curline['acct'], $i, 1);
                        $printRow = false;
                    }
                }

                if ( $printRow ) {
                    $this->_gr_tot_db = ibcadd($thisdb, $this->_gr_tot_db, 14, 1);
                    $this->_gr_tot_cr = ibcadd($thiscr, $this->_gr_tot_cr, 14, 1);
                    $this->_gr_tot_bal = ibcadd(ibcadd($thisbal, $accbalfwd, 14, 1), $this->_gr_tot_bal, 14, 1);
                }

                $thisdb = 0;
                $thiscr = 0;
                $thisbal = 0;
            }
        }

        if ( $curline['element2'] ) {
            $level++;
            for ( $i = count($curline['element2']) - 1; $i >= 0; $i-- ) {
                $firsttrans = false;
                $balfwd =
                    $this->getTotalBalFwdNew($gBalanceAsOfDate[$row] ?? [], $row, $curline['element2'][$i]['CHILDPATH'] ?? '');
                $curline['element2']["$i"]['fwd'] = $balfwd;
                $curline['element2']["$i"]['bal'] = $balfwd;
                $this->BuildReportTotals(
                    $curline['element2']["$i"], $_zeroAcctsWTrans, $_displayAllAccts, $row,
                    $thisdb, $thiscr, $thisbal, $level, $firsttrans, false, $other_level_bal, $balfwd,
                    $curline['element2']["$i"]["recordno"] ?? ''
                );
                $thisleveldb = ibcadd($thisleveldb, $thisdb, 14, 1);
                $thislevelcr = ibcadd($thislevelcr, $thiscr, 14, 1);
                $thislevelbal = ibcadd($thislevelbal, $thisbal, 14, 1);
                $curline['element2']["$i"]['nc'] = ibcsub($thisdb, $thiscr, 14, 1);
                $curline['element2']["$i"]['level'] = $level;
                if ( ( $thisdb == 0 || $thisdb == '' ) && ( $thiscr == 0 || $thiscr == '' )
                     && ( $thisbal == 0
                          || $thisbal == '' ) ) {
                    //if (count($curline['element2']["$i"]['trans']) == 0 || !$curline['element2']["$i"]['trans']) {
                    if ( $curline['element2']["$i"]['fwd'] == 0 || ! isset($_showDeptLocActivity)
                         || $_showDeptLocActivity == 'false' ) {
                        if ( count($curline['element2']) == 1 ) {
                            $curline = array_delete($curline, 'element2');
                        } else {
                            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                            $temp = array_splice($curline['element2'], $i, 1);
                        }
                    }
                }
                $thisdb = 0;
                $thiscr = 0;
                $thisbal = 0;
            }
        }

        if ( $curline['element3'] ) {
            $firsttrans = false;
            $level++;
            for ( $i = count($curline['element3']) - 1; $i >= 0; $i-- ) {
                if ( $on_other ) {
                    $balfwd = $this->getTotalBalFwdNew(($gBalanceAsOfDate[$row] ?? [])['NONE'] ?? [], 'NONE',
                                                       $curline['element3'][$i]['CHILDPATH'] ?? '');
                } else {
                    $balfwd = $this->getTotalBalFwdNew(($gBalanceAsOfDate[$row] ?? [])[$element2Inf] ?? [], $element2Inf,
                                                       $curline['element3'][$i]['CHILDPATH'] ?? '');
                }
                $curline['element3']["$i"]["fwd"] = $balfwd;
                $curline['element3']["$i"]["bal"] = $balfwd;
                $this->BuildReportTotals(
                    $curline['element3']["$i"], $_zeroAcctsWTrans, $_displayAllAccts, $row,
                    $thisdb, $thiscr, $thisbal, $level, $firsttrans, $on_other, $other_level_bal, $balfwd, $element2Inf,
                    $curline['element3']["$i"]["recordno"] ?? ''
                );
                $thisleveldb = ibcadd($thisleveldb, $thisdb, 14, 1);
                $thislevelcr = ibcadd($thislevelcr, $thiscr, 14, 1);
                $curline['element3']["$i"]['nc'] = ibcsub($thisdb, $thiscr, 14, 1);
                $thislevelbal = ibcadd($thislevelbal, $thisbal, 14, 1);
                $curline['element3']["$i"]['level'] = $level;
                if ( ( $thisdb == 0 || $thisdb == '' ) && ( $thiscr == 0 || $thiscr == '' )
                     && ( $thisbal == 0
                          || $thisbal == '' ) ) {
                    //if (count($curline['element3']["$i"]['trans']) == 0 || !$curline['element3']["$i"]['trans']) {
                    if ( $curline['element3']["$i"]["fwd"] == 0 || ! isset($_showDeptLocActivity)
                         || $_showDeptLocActivity == 'false' ) {
                        if ( count($curline['element3']) == 1 ) {
                            $curline = array_delete($curline, 'element3');
                        } else if ( count($curline['element3']) > 1 ) {
                            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                            $temp = array_splice($curline['element3'], $i, 1);
                        }
                    }
                }

                $thisdb = 0;
                $thiscr = 0;
                $thisbal = 0;
            }
        }

        if ( $curline['other'] ) {
            $curline['level'] = $level;
            $firsttrans = false;
            for ( $i = count($curline['other']) - 1; $i >= 0; $i-- ) {
                if ( $on_other ) {
                    $balfwd = $this->getTotalBalFwd((($gBalanceAsOfDate[$row] ?? [])['NONE'] ?? [])['NONE'] ?? []);
                } else {
                    if ( $element2Inf ) {
                        // element2 is set , we need bal fwd for acct-element2 - none
                        $balfwd = $this->getTotalBalFwd((($gBalanceAsOfDate[$row] ?? [])[$element2Inf] ?? [])['NONE'] ?? []);
                    } else {
                        // element2 is not set
                        $balfwd = $this->getTotalBalFwd(($gBalanceAsOfDate[$row] ?? [])['NONE'] ?? []);
                    }
                }
                $curline['other']["$i"]["fwd"] = $balfwd;
                $curline['other']["$i"]["bal"] = $balfwd;
                $this->BuildReportTotals(
                    $curline['other']["$i"], $_zeroAcctsWTrans, $_displayAllAccts, $row,
                    $thisdb, $thiscr, $thisbal, $level, $firsttrans, true, $other_level_bal, $balfwd, $element2Inf,
                    $element3Inf
                );
                $thisleveldb = ibcadd($thisleveldb, $thisdb, 14, 1);
                $thislevelcr = ibcadd($thislevelcr, $thiscr, 14, 1);
                $curline['other']["$i"]['level'] = $level;
                $curline['other']["$i"]['nc'] = ibcsub($thisdb, $thiscr, 14, 1);
                $thislevelbal = ibcadd($thislevelbal, $thisbal, 14, 1);
                if ( ( $thisdb == 0 || $thisdb == '' ) && ( $thiscr == 0 || $thiscr == '' )
                     && ( $thisbal == 0
                          || $thisbal == '' ) ) {
                    //if (count($curline['other']["$i"]['trans']) == 0 || !$curline['other']["$i"]['trans']) {
                    if ( $curline['other']["$i"]["fwd"] == 0 || ! isset($_showDeptLocActivity)
                         || $_showDeptLocActivity == 'false' ) {
                        if ( count($curline['other']) == 1 ) {
                            $curline = array_delete($curline, 'other');
                        } else if ( count($curline['other']) > 1 ) {
                            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                            $temp = array_splice($curline['other'], $i, 1);
                        }
                    }
                }
                $thisdb = 0;
                $thiscr = 0;
                $thisbal = 0;
            }
        }

        if ( $curline['trans'] ) {
            for ( $i = 0; $i < count($curline['trans']); $i++ ) {
                if ( ! isset($curline['trans'][$i]) ) {
                    continue;
                }
                $hassubs = false;
                if ( $curline['trans']["$i"]['sub'] ) {
                    $hassubs = true;
                    $subdb = 0;
                    $subcr = 0;
                    for ( $k = 0; $k < count($curline['trans'][$i]['sub']); $k++ ) {
                        $subdb = ibcadd($subdb, $curline['trans']["$i"]['sub']["$k"]['db'], 14, 1);
                        $subcr = ibcadd($subcr, $curline['trans']["$i"]['sub']["$k"]['cr'], 14, 1);
                        /** @noinspection PhpSillyAssignmentInspection */
                        $curline['trans']["$i"]['sub']["$k"]['db'] = $curline['trans']["$i"]['sub']["$k"]['db'];
                        /** @noinspection PhpSillyAssignmentInspection */
                        $curline['trans']["$i"]['sub']["$k"]['cr'] = $curline['trans']["$i"]['sub']["$k"]['cr'];
                    }
                }
                if ( ( $firsttrans && $i == 0 ) || ( $on_other && $i == 0 ) ) {
                    $firsttrans = false;
                    $balfwd = ibcadd($thisfwd, '0', 14, 1);
                } else if ( ! $firsttrans && $i == 0 ) {
                    $balfwd = ibcadd($thisfwd, '0', 14, 1);
                }
                if ( $hassubs ) {
                    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                    $curline['trans']["$i"]['db'] = $subdb;
                    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                    $curline['trans']["$i"]['cr'] = $subcr;
                }
                $thisleveldb = ibcadd($thisleveldb, $curline['trans']["$i"]['db'], 14, 1);
                $thislevelcr = ibcadd($thislevelcr, $curline['trans']["$i"]['cr'], 14, 1);
                $thislevelbal =
                    ibcadd($thislevelbal, ibcsub($curline['trans']["$i"]['db'], $curline['trans']["$i"]['cr'], 14, 1),
                           14, 1);

                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                $curline['trans']["$i"]['bal'] = ibcadd(ibcsub($thisleveldb, $thislevelcr, 14, 1), $balfwd, 14, 1);

                /** @noinspection PhpSillyAssignmentInspection */
                $curline['trans']["$i"]['db'] = $curline['trans']["$i"]['db'];
                /** @noinspection PhpSillyAssignmentInspection */
                $curline['trans']["$i"]['cr'] = $curline['trans']["$i"]['cr'];
                /** @noinspection PhpSillyAssignmentInspection */
                $curline['trans']["$i"]['bal'] = $curline['trans']["$i"]['bal'];
            }
            $thisdb = 0;
            $thiscr = 0;
            $thisbal = 0;
        }

        if ( ! $curline['other']
             &&
             ! $curline['trans']
             &&
             ! $curline['group']
             &&
             ! ( $curline['acct'] ?? false )
             &&
             ! $curline['sub']
             &&
             ! $curline['element2']
             &&
             ! $curline['element3'] ) {
            $thisdb = 0;
            $thiscr = 0;
            $thisbal = 0;

            return;
        }

        if ( $level > 1 ) {
            $thisdb = $thisleveldb ? (float) $thisleveldb : 0;
            $thiscr = $thislevelcr ? (float) $thislevelcr : 0;
            $thisbal = $thislevelbal ? (float) $thislevelbal : 0;
        }

        if ( ! $curline['acct'] && ! $curline['group'] ) {
            $curline['db'] = $thisleveldb ? : 0;
            $curline['cr'] = $thislevelcr ? : 0;
            $curline['bal'] = ibcadd($thislevelbal ? : 0, $thisfwd, 14, 1);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Add dimension value inside the transaction
     *
     * @param string[] &$entry
     * @param array    &$transarray
     */
    private function AddDimensionValuesInTrans(&$entry, &$transarray)
    {
        // get the dimensions information to show
        $showdimensions = explode('#~#', $this->params['SHOWDIMENSIONVALUES']);
        $dimcount = count($showdimensions);
        $dimensionTrans = [];

        for ( $i = 0; $i < $dimcount; $i++ ) {
            if ( $showdimensions[$i] == '' || $showdimensions[$i] == 'None' ) {
                continue;
            }
            [ $dimentity, $dimvalue ] = explode('__', $showdimensions[$i]);
            $dimParams = $this->dimensions[$dimentity];

            if ( $dimParams['isplatform'] ) {
                $dimentity = 'CUSTDIM_' . $dimParams['objid'] . "__";
            }

            if ( isset($dimParams['subElement']) && $dimParams['subElement'] == true ) {
                continue;
            }
            $dimensionTrans['dimension'][] = [ 'value' => $entry[isl_strtoupper($dimentity . $dimvalue)] ];
        }
        $transarray['dimensionTrans'][] = $dimensionTrans;
    }

    /**
     * @param string[] $entry         the transaction record which will be used to populate the "lines" contains the
     *                                database output, which will be groomed for display
     * @param string   $_detailFlag   flag to find out user selection for a detailed report
     * @param string   $_subtotalFlag flag to find out user selection for a detailed report with subtotals
     * @param int[]    $ctaAdjAcctKey
     * @param string   $bookidJrnlSym
     * @param string   $verb
     *
     * @return array Return the groomed 'entry' .. for display purpose. this entry will contain the subtransaction too
     *               if needed
     *               NOTES: based on teh number of subtransactions and detailed - subtotals the transaction
     *               recors may increase eg, if only detailed report is required and no subtotals are needed, then the
     *               passed entry and its subtransactuions will be returned as if all of them were transactions
     */
    function getReworkedTrans(                            $entry, $_detailFlag, $_subtotalFlag, $ctaAdjAcctKey,
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedParameterInspection */ $bookidJrnlSym, $verb)
    {
        $_showdetail = $_detailFlag; // this is done so that the exisiting copy paste works!!!!
        $_showsubtotal = $_subtotalFlag; // this is done so that the exisiting copy paste works!!!!
        $_reportingBook = $this->params['reportingBook'] ? : GetDefaultBook();
        $sublines = [];
        $thelines = []; // this is the array that we have to retun
        $subreccount = '0';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $entity = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $batchno = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $recno = '';
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $trtype = '';
        $_showTransactionNumber =
            ( isset($this->params['showTransactionNumber']) && $this->params['showTransactionNumber'] == 'true' ) ? true
                : false;

        if ( $entry['MODULEKEY'] != '2.GL' ) {
            $type = 'mod';
        } else {
            $type = 'gl';
        }
        if ( $entry['TR_TYPE'] == '-1' ) {
            $credit = $entry['AMOUNT'];
            $debit = '';
        } else {
            $debit = $entry['AMOUNT'];
            $credit = '';
        }

        // Build the drill down URL for the GL transaction
        $drillDownParams = [
            'j'  => $entry['SYMBOL'],
            'do' => $verb,
            'r'  => $entry['BATCH#'],
            'fo' => 'gl',
        ];

        if ( $_showTransactionNumber ) {
            $thelines[0]["batch_no"] = $entry["BATCH_NO"];
        }
        // build drill filter params
        $drillParams = [];
        // Unset the location filter on drilling down for tier consolidation book having subsidiary books
        $unsetLocForDrillDown = false;
        $drillParams['_obj__selPeriodIndex'] = $this->params['selPeriodIndex'];
        $drillParams['_obj__asofdate'] = $this->params['asofdate'];
        $drillParams['_obj__ytdbal'] = $this->params['ytdbal'];
        $drillParams['_obj__reportingBook'] = GetDefaultBook();
        $drillParams['_obj__statAccts'] = $this->params['statAccts'];;
        if ( $this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET'] ) {
            $drillParams['_obj__REPORTINGACCOUNTSET'] = $this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET'];
            $drillParams['_obj__REPORTINGACCOUNTS'] = true;
        }

        $isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable = GLGroupReporter::getIsBookPostingToCSNEntryTable();

        // If reporting book is a consolidation book
        if ( $this->params['isConsolidationBook'] ) {
            //Get current month period start date and end date based on entry_date. This current date is same
            // for non standard companies
            $DateTmpl = new DateTemplates();
            // Based on entry's posted date, we get reporting period start date and end date and we generate trx amount
            // drilldown. This reporting period is same for all the entities hence no need to get the date range based
            // on locationkey. 
            $dates = $DateTmpl->GetDateRange(DATETMPL_CURRENTMONTH, $entry['ENTRY_DATE']);
            $drillParams['_obj__startdate'] = FormatDateForDisplay($dates[0]);
            $drillParams['_obj__enddate'] = FormatDateForDisplay($dates[1]);

            // here we set the key whether the key is SYMBOL or BOOKKEY based on new or old table.
            $symbol = 'SYMBOL';
            if ( $isBookPostingToCSNEntryTable ) {
                $symbol = 'BOOKKEY';

                // In the case for tier consolidation books, for the roll-up entity, system should pick data from its
                // subsidiary book and entity. In this case, reporting book is no longer ACCRUAL, it will be subsidiary book
                // unset the location filter on drilling down for tier consolidation book having subsidiary books
                $subsidiaryBook = $this->entityBookMapForTier[$entry['LOCATION#']];
                if ( isset($entry['LOCATION#']) && isset($subsidiaryBook) && $subsidiaryBook != '' ) {
                    $drillParams['_obj__reportingBook'] = $subsidiaryBook;
                    $unsetLocForDrillDown = true;
                }
            }

            //If other adj books are added and SOURCEBOOKID is not ACCRUAL
            // When the report is run for adj books ie GAAP and not including reporting book (ACCRUAL and CASH)
            // on drill-down, do not include reporting book
            // below condition checks whether adj books are set and its source book is not ACCRUAL and CASH then set 
            // adj book as GAAP/UDB
            if ( $this->params['ADJUSTMENTBOOK'] != ''
                 && ! in_array(
                    $this->sourceBookIDMap[$entry[$symbol]], [ 'ACCRUAL', 'CASH' ]
                )
            ) {
                $drillParams['_obj__ADJUSTMENTBOOK'] = $this->sourceBookIDMap[$entry[$symbol]];
                //If you drilldown GAAP account, we should not show ACCRUAL record so we should include it
                $drillParams['_obj__INCLUDEREPBOOK'] = 'false';
            } else {
                $drillParams['_obj__ADJUSTMENTBOOK'] = '';
                $drillParams['_obj__INCLUDEREPBOOK'] = $this->params['INCLUDEREPBOOK'];
            }
        } else {
            $drillParams['_obj__startdate'] = FormatDateForDisplay($this->_gPeriodRecords[0]['START_DATE']);
            $drillParams['_obj__enddate'] = FormatDateForDisplay($this->_gPeriodRecords[0]['END_DATE']);
            $drillParams['_obj__ADJUSTMENTBOOK'] = $this->params['ADJUSTMENTBOOK'];
            $drillParams['_obj__INCLUDEREPBOOK'] = $this->params['INCLUDEREPBOOK'];
        }

        if ( $_showsubtotal == "true" ) {
            if ( ! isset($_showdetail) || $_showdetail == 'S' || $entry['MODULEKEY'] == '2.GL' ) {
                $thelines[0]["matchingcode"] = $entry['MATCHINGCODE'] ?? '';
                $thelines[0]["matchingstatus"] = $entry['MATCHINGSTATUS'] ?? '';
                $thelines[0]["date"] = $entry['ENTRY_DATE'];
                $thelines[0]["docdate"] = $entry['ENTRY_DATE'];
                $thelines[0]["title"] = $entry['TITLE'];
                $thelines[0]["doc"] = $entry['DOCUMENT'];
                $thelines[0]["memo"] = $entry['DESCRIPTION'] ? : $entry['TITLE'];
                $thelines[0]["sym"] = $entry['SYMBOL'];
                $thelines[0]["state"] = $this->txnStateMap[$entry['STATE']];
                //We need to use cny# of subsidiary entity to allow slide-in with drill down link.
                $thelines[0]["ce"] = $this->subsidiaryRecordKeyMap[$entry['CHILDENTITY']] ? : '';
                $thelines[0]["ownerloc"] = $entry['OWNERLOC'];
                $thelines[0]["loc"] = $entry['LOCATION#'];
                $thelines[0]["dpt"] = $entry['DEPT#'];
                $thelines[0]["locname"] = $entry['LOCNAME'];
                $thelines[0]["deptname"] = $entry['DEPTNAME'];
                if ( $thelines[0]["ce"] && $_showdetail == 'D' ) {
                    $thelines[0]["ac"] = $entry['ACCOUNT#'];
                }
                $thelines[0]["currency"] = $this->getCurrency($entry);
                $thelines[0]["transamount"] = ( $entry['TRX_AMOUNT'] ? : ( $debit ? : $credit ) );

                $thelines[0]["type"] = $type;
                $thelines[0]["db"] = $debit;
                $thelines[0]["cr"] = $credit;
                $thelines[0]["bal"] = '';
                $thelines[0]['accounthash'] = $entry['ACCOUNT#']; // not needed for anything, added for debug purpose
                $thelines[0]['iscta'] = in_array($entry['ACCOUNT#'], $ctaAdjAcctKey) ? 'T' : 'F';
                $thelines[0]['glbatchscript'] = GLBatchEditor::buildDrillDownUrl($drillDownParams);
                $thelines[0]["glownerloc"] = $entry['OWNERLOC'];
            } else {
                //in here is where subtransactions are found and added
                if ( $this->addSubTransaction($thelines, $entry, $sublines, $subreccount, $verb)
                     && $subreccount >= 1
                ) {
                    if ( $subreccount > 1 ) {
                        $thelines[0]["matchingcode"] = $entry['MATCHINGCODE'] ?? '';
                        $thelines[0]["matchingstatus"] = $entry['MATCHINGSTATUS'] ?? '';
                        $thelines[0]["date"] = $entry['ENTRY_DATE'];
                        $thelines[0]["title"] = $entry['TITLE'];
                        $thelines[0]["doc"] = $entry['DOCUMENT'];
                        $thelines[0]["memo"] = $entry['DESCRIPTION'] ? : $entry['TITLE'];
                        $thelines[0]["sym"] = $entry['SYMBOL'];
                        $thelines[0]["state"] = $this->txnStateMap[$entry['STATE']];
                        $thelines[0]["currency"] = $this->getCurrency($entry);
                        $thelines[0]["transamount"] = ( $entry['TRX_AMOUNT'] ? : '' );

                        $thelines[0]["type"] = $type;
                        $thelines[0]["db"] = '';
                        $thelines[0]["cr"] = '';
                        $thelines[0]["bal"] = '';
                        $thelines[0]["ce"] = '';
                        //add the sublines into the array here
                        $thelines[0]['accounthash'] =
                            $entry['ACCOUNT#']; // not needed for anything, added for debug purpose
                        $thelines[0]['iscta'] = in_array($entry['ACCOUNT#'], $ctaAdjAcctKey) ? 'T' : 'F';
                        $thelines[0]['glbatchscript'] = GLBatchEditor::buildDrillDownUrl($drillDownParams);
                        $thelines[0]["glownerloc"] = $entry['OWNERLOC'];
                        $thelines[0]["sub"] = $sublines;
                    }
                } else {
                    // there are no sub trans and entry is not for 2.GL
                    // could be some other module hitting gl with MODULEKEY != 2.GL and
                    // some examples are 7.INV 8.SO etc (need to take a look at it)
                    $thelines[0]["matchingcode"] = $entry['MATCHINGCODE'] ?? '';
                    $thelines[0]["matchingstatus"] = $entry['MATCHINGSTATUS'] ?? '';
                    $thelines[0]["date"] = $entry['ENTRY_DATE'];
                    $thelines[0]["docdate"] = $entry['ENTRY_DATE'];
                    $thelines[0]["title"] = $entry['TITLE'];
                    $thelines[0]["doc"] = $entry['DOCUMENT'];

                    if ( $_reportingBook != 'CASH'
                         && in_array($entry['RECORDTYPE'], [ 'pi', 'pa', 'ri', 'ra', 'ci', 'ct', 'cp', 'cb', 'cd' ])
                         && $thelines[0]["doc"] == '' ) {
                        $thelines[0]["doc"] = $entry['RECORDID'];
                    }

                    $thelines[0]["memo"] = $entry['DESCRIPTION'] ? : $entry['TITLE'];
                    $thelines[0]["sym"] = $entry['SYMBOL'];
                    $thelines[0]["state"] = $this->txnStateMap[$entry['STATE']];
                    //We need to use cny# of subsidiary entity to allow slide-in with drill down link.
                    $thelines[0]["ce"] = $this->subsidiaryRecordKeyMap[$entry['CHILDENTITY']] ? : '';
                    $thelines[0]["loc"] = $entry['LOCATION#'];
                    $thelines[0]["ownerloc"] = $entry['OWNERLOC'];
                    $thelines[0]["dpt"] = $entry['DEPT#'];
                    $thelines[0]["locname"] = $entry['LOCNAME'];
                    $thelines[0]["deptname"] = $entry['DEPTNAME'];
                    if ( $thelines[0]["ce"] && $_showdetail == 'D' ) {
                        $thelines[0]["ac"] = $entry['ACCOUNT#'];
                    }
                    $thelines[0]["currency"] = $this->getCurrency($entry);
                    $thelines[0]["transamount"] = ( $entry['TRX_AMOUNT'] ? : ( $debit ? : $credit ) );
                    $thelines[0]["type"] = $type;
                    $thelines[0]["db"] = $debit;
                    $thelines[0]["cr"] = $credit;
                    $thelines[0]["bal"] = '';
                    $thelines[0]['accounthash'] =
                        $entry['ACCOUNT#']; // not needed for anything, added for debug purpose
                    $thelines[0]['iscta'] = in_array($entry['ACCOUNT#'], $ctaAdjAcctKey) ? 'T' : 'F';
                    $thelines[0]['glbatchscript'] = GLBatchEditor::buildDrillDownUrl($drillDownParams);
                    $thelines[0]["glownerloc"] = $entry['OWNERLOC'];
                }
            }
        } else {
            if ( ! isset($_showdetail) || $_showdetail == 'S' || $entry['MODULEKEY'] == '2.GL' ) {
                $thelines[0]["date"] = $entry['ENTRY_DATE'];

    /**
     * @param array    &$lines an array which will contain the actual report contents line by line. *** OUTPUT PARAM ***
     * @param string[]  $entry the transaction record which will be used to populate the "lines"
     * @param array    &$sublines
     * @param int      &$numofrecs
     * @param string    $verb
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    function addSubTransaction(&$lines, $entry, &$sublines, &$numofrecs, $verb)
    {
        $_showTransactionNumber =
            ( isset($this->params['showTransactionNumber']) && $this->params['showTransactionNumber'] == 'true' ) ? true
                : false;
        // GRADY GL DETAIL CASH BASIS REPORT - Modified by: aps (next 1 line)
        $gTransactionOffsets = $this->_gTranscationOffsets;
        $detailop = $this->_detailop;
        $_showsubtotal = $this->params["showsubtotal"];

        // get the respective subtrans from the global array that we created sometime back
        if ( $this->_gSubTransCount < 1 ) {
            // stop processing right away
            /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
            $modRecords = []; // assign empy array so that count is always zero
            $sublines = []; // assign empty array so that count is always zero
            $numofrecs = 0;

            // let the caller know, that there are no subtransactions to process
            return false;
        } else {
            // GRADY GL DETAIL CASH BASIS REPORT - Modified by: aps (next 1 lines)
            $this->setGSubTranscationRecs($gTransactionOffsets, $entry);

            $modRecords = $this->_gSubTranscationRecs[$entry["RECORD#"]] ?? [];
        }

        $thereisonlyone = false;
        $numofrecs = count($modRecords);
        if ( $numofrecs == 1 ) {
            $thereisonlyone = true;
        } else if ( $numofrecs == 0 ) {
            return false;
        }
        /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
        $y = 0;

        for ( $y = 0; $y < $numofrecs; $y++ ) {
            $polarity = $modRecords[$y]['TR_TYPE'];
            if ( $polarity == 1 ) {
                $debit = ibcabs($modRecords[$y]['AMOUNT']);
                $credit = '';
            } else {
                $debit = '';
                $credit = ibcabs($modRecords[$y]['AMOUNT']);
            }
            // THIS RECORDTYPE SWITCH IS TO DISPLY FUNDS TRANSFERS THAT ARE REALLY CREDIT CARD CHARGES AS TRANSFERS
            // THIS MUST HAPPEN AFTER THE POLARITY IS CALCULATED!
            if ( $modRecords[$y]['ISFUNDSTXFER'] ) {
                $modRecords[$y]['RECORDTYPE'] = CM_TRANSFUNDS_RECTYPE;
            }
            // if AP Discount assume PARENTPAYMENT record# as RECORD# and reassign RECORDTYPE as pi for 
            // the drill down purposes since the drill down from discount should go to Bill screen.
            $entNameStr = ( $modRecords[$y]["ENTNAME"] ) ? ' - ' . $modRecords[$y]["ENTNAME"] : "";
            $entDescStr = ( $modRecords[$y]['DESCRIPTION'] ) ? ":  " . $modRecords[$y]['DESCRIPTION'] : "";

            // GRADY GL DETAIL CASH BASIS REPORT - Modified by: aps (next 1 lines)
            $appendbillinfo = $this->appendBillinfo($modRecords, $y);

            $memofield = isset($detailop[$modRecords[$y]['RECORDTYPE']][$modRecords[$y]['FINACCTTYPE']])
                ? ( $detailop[$modRecords[$y]['RECORDTYPE']][$modRecords[$y]['FINACCTTYPE']]['short'] . $entNameStr

                : ( $detailop[$modRecords[$y]['RECORDTYPE']]['short'] . $entNameStr . $entDescStr . $appendbillinfo );

            // Build the drill down URL for the GL transaction
            $drillDownParams = [
                'j'  => $entry['SYMBOL'],
                'do' => $verb,
                'r'  => $entry['BATCH#'],
                'fo' => 'gl',
            ];

            if ( ! $thereisonlyone && $_showsubtotal == "true" ) {
                $subArray = [];

                $subArray["matchingstatus"] = $entry['MATCHINGSTATUS'] ?? '';

                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                if ( $_reportingBook != 'CASH'

                                 [ 'pi', 'pa', 'ri', 'ra', 'ci', 'ct', 'cp', 'cb', 'cd' ])
                     && $subArray['doc'] == '' ) {
                    $subArray['doc'] = addslashes($modRecords[$y]['RECORDID'] ?? '');
                }

                $subArray['memo'] = $memofield;
                $subArray['title'] = $memofield;
                $subArray['sym'] = $entry['SYMBOL'];
                $subArray['db'] = $debit;
                $subArray['cr'] = $credit;
                $subArray['currency'] = $this->getCurrency($entry);
                $subArray['transamount'] =
                    ( $modRecords[$y]['TRX_AMOUNT'] ? ibcabs($modRecords[$y]['TRX_AMOUNT']) : ( $debit ? : $credit ) );
                $subArray['bal'] = '';
                $subArray['trtype'] = $modRecords[$y]['RECORDTYPE'];
                $subArray['type'] = 'mod';
                $subArray['paymethodkey'] = $modRecords[$y]['PAYMETHODKEY'];
                $subArray['finaccttype'] = $modRecords[$y]['FINACCTTYPE'];
                $subArray['ent'] = $modRecords[$y]['ENTITY'];
                $subArray['batchno'] = $modRecords[$y]['PRBATCHKEY'];
                $subArray['recno'] = $modRecords[$y]['RECORD#'];
                $subArray['acctno'] = $entry['ACCT_NO'];
                $subArray["ce"] = '';
                $subArray["locname"] = $modRecords[$y]['LOCNAME'];
                $subArray["deptname"] = $modRecords[$y]['DEPTNAME'];
                $subArray['dpt'] = $entry['DEPT#'];
                $subArray['loc'] = $entry['LOCATION#'];
                $subArray["ownerloc"] = $entry['OWNERLOC'] ? : $modRecords[$y]['SUBOWNERLOC'];
                $subArray["glownerloc"] = $entry['OWNERLOC'];
                $subArray['glbatchscript'] = GLBatchEditor::buildDrillDownUrl($drillDownParams);

                // Add dimensions values into the sub transation array
                $this->AddDimensionValuesInTrans($entry, $subArray);

            }
            if ( $thereisonlyone || ! isset($_showsubtotal) || $_showsubtotal == "false" || $_showsubtotal == "" ) {
                if ( $_showTransactionNumber ) {
                    $lines[$y]["batch_no"] = $lines[0]["batch_no"];

                $lines[$y]["doc"] = addslashes($modRecords[$y]['DOCNUMBER'] ?? '');

                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                if ( $_reportingBook != 'CASH'
                     && in_array($modRecords[$y]['RECORDTYPE'],
                                 [ 'pi', 'pa', 'ri', 'ra', 'ci', 'ct', 'cp', 'cb', 'cd' ])
                     && $lines[$y]["doc"] == '' ) {
                    $lines[$y]["doc"] = addslashes($modRecords[$y]['RECORDID'] ?? '');
                }

                $lines[$y]["memo"] = $memofield;
                $lines[$y]["title"] = $memofield;
                $lines[$y]["sym"] = $entry['SYMBOL'];
                $lines[$y]["state"] = $this->txnStateMap[$entry['STATE']];
                $lines[$y]["glrec"] = $entry['BATCH#'];
                $lines[$y]["trtype"] = $modRecords[$y]['RECORDTYPE'];
                $lines[$y]["type"] = 'mod';
                $lines[$y]['paymethodkey'] = $modRecords[$y]['PAYMETHODKEY'];
                $lines[$y]['finaccttype'] = $modRecords[$y]['FINACCTTYPE'];
                $lines[$y]["db"] = $debit;
                $lines[$y]["cr"] = $credit;
                $lines[$y]['currency'] = $this->getCurrency($entry);
                $lines[$y]['transamount'] =
                    ( $modRecords[$y]['TRX_AMOUNT'] ? ibcabs($modRecords[$y]['TRX_AMOUNT']) : ( $debit ? : $credit ) );
                // $lines[$y]["bal"] = '';
                $lines[$y]["ent"] = $modRecords[$y]['ENTITY'];
                $lines[$y]['batchno'] = $modRecords[$y]['PRBATCHKEY'];
                $lines[$y]['recno'] = $modRecords[$y]['RECORD#'];
                $lines[$y]["acctno"] = $entry['ACCT_NO'];
                $lines[$y]["ce"] = '';
                $lines[$y]["loc"] = $entry['LOCATION#'];

            }

    }

    /**
     * @return array
     */
    function GetOffsetAccounts()
    {
        $accts = [];
        $offsetclause = '';
        $ismega = IsMultiEntityCompany();
        if ( $ismega ) {
            $loc = GetContextLocation();
            if ($loc != '') {
                $offsetclause = " and nvl(locationkey, :6) = :6 ";
            }
        }

        // AP/AR offset accounts, including entity-specific ones
        $qry[0] = "select b.record# from apsetup m, baseaccount b ".
                  "where m.cny# = :1 and b.cny# = :1 and m.modulekey = '3.AP' ".
                  "and (m.apglaccountkey = b.record# or m.advanceglaccountkey = b.record#) ";
        $qry[0] .= "union select b.record# from arsetup m, baseaccount b ".
                   "where m.cny# = :1 and b.cny# = :1 and m.modulekey='4.AR'
                  and arglaccountkey=b.record# ";

        // AP/AR/EE account labels offset accounts, if any
        /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
        $qry[0] .= "union " .
                   "select gloffsetkey as record# from accountlabel " .
                   "where cny# = :1 and gloffsetkey is not null " . $offsetclause .
                   "and modulekey in (select distinct modulekey from modulepref " .
                   "where cny# = :1 and property = :2 and value = :3 and modulekey <> '3.AP' ".
                   "union select modulekey from apsetup where cny# = :1 and label = :7) ";

        // PO/SO/INV offset accounts
        $qry[0] .= "union ".
                   "select b.record# from offsetacct o, baseaccount b ".
                   "where o.cny# = :1 and b.cny# = :1 ".
                   "and o.isoffset = :4 and o.glaccountrecordno = b.record# ";

        // Inter-entity offsets
        if ($ismega) {
            $qry[0] .= "union ".
                       "select iepayableacctkey as record# from location ".
                       "where cny# = :1 and locationtype = :5 ".
                       "and iepayableacctkey is not null ".
                       "union ".
                       "select iereceivableacctkey as record# from location ".
                       "where cny# = :1 and locationtype = :5 ".
                       "and iereceivableacctkey is not null ";
        }

        $qry[1] = GetMyCompany();
        $qry[2] = 'LABEL';
        $qry[3] = 'true';
        $qry[4] = 'T';
        $qry[5] = 'E';
        $qry[6] = 'E';
        $qry[7] = 'T';

        if ( $offsetclause != '' ) {
            /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
            $qry[6] = $loc;
        }

        $results = QueryResult($qry);

        foreach ( $results as $result ) {
            $accts[] = $result['RECORD#'];
        }

        return $accts;
    }

    /**
     * convert to a new group map temporarily
     * $new_group_map[$key_date]['numeric'][$key_doc]
     * $new_group_map[$key_date]['non-numeric'][$key_doc]
     * and flatten back to the original structure
     *
     * @param array  &$tempTransArray
     * @param string  $_subtotalFlag
     */
    function GetSortMap(&$tempTransArray, $_subtotalFlag)
    {
        $_showsubtotal = $_subtotalFlag; // this is done so that the exisiting copy paste works!!!!
        $new_group_map = [];
        $new_sub_map = [];
        $sort_target_1 = $sort_target_2 = [];
        foreach ( $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['trans'] as $row ) {
            if ( $_showsubtotal == "true" && ! empty($row['sub']) ) {
                unset($new_sub_map);
                foreach ( $row['sub'] as $sub ) {
                    $key_sub_doc = $sub['doc'];
                    if ( is_numeric($key_sub_doc) ) {
                        $new_sub_map['numeric'][] = $sub;
                    } else {
                        $new_sub_map['non-numeric'][] = $sub;
                    }
                }

                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                if ( ! empty($new_sub_map['numeric']) && count($new_sub_map['numeric']) > 1 ) {
                    unset($sort_target_1, $sort_target_2);
                    for ( $i = 0; $i < count($new_sub_map['numeric']); $i++ ) {
                        $sort_target_1[] = $new_sub_map['numeric'][$i]['doc'];
                        $sort_target_2[] = self::upperCaseFieldForArraySort($new_sub_map['numeric'][$i]['locname']);
                    }
                    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                    array_multisort($sort_target_1, SORT_NUMERIC, $sort_target_2, SORT_STRING, $new_sub_map['numeric']);
                }

                if ( ! empty($new_sub_map['non-numeric']) && count($new_sub_map['non-numeric']) > 1 ) {
                    unset($sort_target_1, $sort_target_2);
                    for ( $i = 0; $i < count($new_sub_map['non-numeric']); $i++ ) {
                        $sort_target_1[] = self::upperCaseFieldForArraySort($new_sub_map['non-numeric'][$i]['doc']);
                        $sort_target_2[] = self::upperCaseFieldForArraySort($new_sub_map['non-numeric'][$i]['locname']);
                    }
                    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                    array_multisort($sort_target_1, SORT_STRING, $sort_target_2, SORT_STRING,
                                    $new_sub_map['non-numeric']);
                }

                $row['sub'] = INTACCTarray_merge($new_sub_map['numeric'], $new_sub_map['non-numeric']);
            }

            $key_date = $row['date'];
            $key_doc = $row['doc'];
            if ( is_numeric($key_doc) ) {
                $new_group_map[$key_date]['numeric'][] = $row;
            } else {
                $new_group_map[$key_date]['non-numeric'][] = $row;
            }
        }

        $new_date_group_map = [];
        foreach ( $new_group_map as $key_date => $row_item ) {
            if ( countArray($row_item['numeric']) > 1 ) {
                unset($sort_target_1, $sort_target_2);
                for ( $i = 0; $i < count($row_item['numeric']); $i++ ) {
                    $sort_target_1[] = $row_item['numeric'][$i]['doc'];
                    $sort_target_2[] = self::upperCaseFieldForArraySort($row_item['numeric'][$i]['locname']);
                }
                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                array_multisort($sort_target_1, SORT_NUMERIC, $sort_target_2, SORT_STRING, $row_item['numeric']);
            }

            if ( countArray($row_item['non-numeric']) > 1 ) {
                unset($sort_target_1, $sort_target_2);
                for ( $i = 0; $i < count($row_item['non-numeric']); $i++ ) {
                    $sort_target_1[] = self::upperCaseFieldForArraySort($row_item['non-numeric'][$i]['doc']);
                    $sort_target_2[] = self::upperCaseFieldForArraySort($row_item['non-numeric'][$i]['locname']);
                }
                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                array_multisort($sort_target_1, SORT_STRING, $sort_target_2, SORT_STRING, $row_item['non-numeric']);
            }

            $new_date_group_map[$key_date] = INTACCTarray_merge($row_item['numeric'], $row_item['non-numeric']);
        }

        $tempTransArray['acct'][0]['trans'] = $this->array_flatten($new_date_group_map);
    }

    /**
     * Description: This will apply the filters on the map and do
     * the get list on nativetoreportingacmap.
     */
    protected function initNativeToRptAcs()
    {
        $_ac = Request::$r->_ac;
        if ( ! empty($this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET']) ) {
            $gManagerFactory = Globals::$g->gManagerFactory;
            $reportingAcMapMgr = $gManagerFactory->getManager('nativetoreportingacmap');
            //If we come From Dashboard
            if ( ! empty($this->params['reportparams']) ) {
                $this->params['acct'] = $this->params['reportparams']['acct'];
                $this->params['acctto'] = $this->params['reportparams']['acctto'];
                $this->params['multiAcc'] = $this->params['reportparams']['multiAcc'];
            }

            //In Offline-Mode Capture Everything that we stored regarding filters
            if ( $this->params['offline_mode'] ) {
                if ( ! empty($this->params['offlineacct']) ) {
                    $this->params['acct'] = $this->params['offlineacct'];
                }
                if ( ! empty($this->params['offlineacctto']) ) {
                    $this->params['acctto'] = $this->params['offlineacctto'];
                }
                if ( ! empty($this->params['offlinemultiAcc']) ) {
                    $this->params['multiAccFrom'] = '';
                    $this->params['multiAcc'] = $this->params['offlinemultiAcc'];
                }
            } else {
                //Store the Reporting Info for offline
                $this->params['offlineacct'] = $this->params['acct'];
                $this->params['offlineacctto'] = $this->params['acctto'];
                $this->params['offlinemultiAcc'] = $this->params['multiAcc'];
            }

            [ $_acctno ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($this->params['acct']));
            [ $_accttono ] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, isl_trim($this->params['acctto']));

            //Parse the Multi Account filter
            if ( ! empty($this->params['multiAcc']) && $this->params['multiAccFrom'] != 'Reporting' ) {
                // backward compatibility, replace enter key with new symbol
                $this->params['multiAcc'] = str_replace("\n", $this->multiAccSeparator, $this->params['multiAcc']);
                $multiAccountlines = explode($this->multiAccSeparator, $this->params['multiAcc']);
                $multiAccountFrom = [];
                $multiAccountTo = [];
                foreach ( $multiAccountlines as $line ) {
                    if ( ! empty($line) ) {
                        [ $_frm, $_to ] = explode("->", $line);
                        $multiAccountFrom[] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, trim($_frm));
                        $multiAccountTo[] = explode(PICK_RECVAL_SEP, trim($_to));
                    }
                }
            }

            //Construct the Query using From and To
            if ( ! empty($multiAccountFrom) && ! empty($multiAccountTo) ) {
                $ctr = 0;
                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                $acctFilter .= " and (";
                /** @noinspection PhpUnusedLocalVariableInspection */
                foreach ( $multiAccountFrom as $__acc_frm ) {
                    $__from = $multiAccountFrom[$ctr][0];
                    $__to = $multiAccountTo[$ctr][0];
                    $acctFilter .= " (ra.reportingacno >= '$__from' ";
                    $acctFilter .= " and ra.reportingacno <= '$__to' ";
                    $acctFilter .= " ) or";
                    $ctr += 1;
                }
                /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                $acctFilter = substr($acctFilter, 0, ( $len - 2 ));
                $acctFilter .= " ) ";

                $subquery =
                    "select reportingacno from reportingac ra where ra.cny# = nativetoreportingacmap.cny# and  ra.reportingachdrkey = nativetoreportingacmap.reportingachdrkey $acctFilter";

                $extrafilter = [ 'REPORTINGACNO', 'INSUBQUERY', $subquery ];
            }

            /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
            $results =
                $reportingAcMapMgr->GetNativetoRepotingACMap($this->params['REPORTINGACCOUNTSET'], $_ac, $_acctno,
                                                             $_accttono, $extrafilter);

            if ( ! empty($results) ) {
                foreach ( $results as $val ) {
                    $native_acttno = $val['NATIVEACNO'];
                    $this->nativeToRptAcs[$native_acttno] = $val;
                    $this->_nativeToRptKeyedAcs[$val['NATIVEACKEY']] = $val;
                    if ( $native_acttno ) {
                        $nativeacs[] = $native_acttno . '->' . $native_acttno;
                    }
                }
                //We need to unset the from and to accounts as they are belongs to the Repoting GL Accounts
                //We need to pass the MultiAcc Filter withe our Mapped Nativet Accounts.
                if ( ! empty($_ac) || ! empty($this->params['multiAcc'])
                     || ( ! empty($this->params['acct'])
                          || ! empty($this->params['acctto']) ) ) {
                    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedVariableInspection */
                    $this->params['multiAcc'] = implode($this->multiAccSeparator, $nativeacs);
                    $this->params['multiAccFrom'] = 'Reporting';
                    $this->params['acct'] = '';
                    $this->params['acctto'] = '';
                    unset(Request::$r->_ac);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param string $accSetValue
     * @param string $locSetValue
     * @param string $deptSetValue
     */
    function getGroupedTxnsByDeptLoc( string $accSetValue, string $locSetValue, string $deptSetValue) 
    {
        $gTranscationRecs = &$this->_gTranscationRecs;
        // recreate the transactions array based on the group by as requested by the user based on location or department
        if ( Util::countOrZero($gTranscationRecs) > 0 ) {
            // we have transaction records
            $tempTransArray = [];

            foreach ( $gTranscationRecs as $transDetails ) {

                if( empty($locSetValue) &&  empty($deptSetValue) && $accSetValue === 'ACCOUNT#' ){
                    // default the group by option to 'none'
                    $tempTransArray[$transDetails[$accSetValue]][] = $transDetails;
                }
                else{

                    if ( Request::$r->_type === kShowCSV || ( isset($this->params['offreporttype'])
                            && $this->params['offreporttype'] === kShowCSV ) ) {
                        $transDetails['ENTRY_DATE'] = FormatDateForDisplay($transDetails['ENTRY_DATE']);
                    }

                    if( !empty($locSetValue) &&  !empty($deptSetValue) &&  !empty($accSetValue) ){
                        // the group by selection is loc-dept or dept-loc
                        $tempTransArray[$transDetails[$accSetValue]][$transDetails[$locSetValue]][$transDetails[$deptSetValue]][] =
                            $transDetails;
                    }else{
                        // the group by selection is loc or dep
                        $tempTransArray[$transDetails[$accSetValue]][$transDetails[$locSetValue]][] = $transDetails;
                    }

                }

            }

            // reassign the temp array to global array
            $gTranscationRecs = $tempTransArray;
            unset($tempTransArray);
        }
        
    }
